[Mrs. Cacturon]
Lecter, you should thank the adventurer first.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
莱克特，你应该先谢谢冒险者。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I think he's too busy stirring the juice to hear you. It's okay. I didn't do this to get thanked. He really must love it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我觉得他正忙着搅拌果汁，可能听不见。没关系。我做这些不是为了得到感谢。他真的很喜欢这个。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Yes, I love it! A lot! Heh heh! Thank you!
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
是的，我很喜欢！非常喜欢！嘿嘿！谢谢你！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
唉...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
He's happy. Why are you sighing?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
他看起来很开心。你为什么要叹气呢？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Watching him so happy to drink that fake juice reminds me of the real agave juice I used to drink when I was young.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
看着他这么开心地喝着那种假果汁，让我想起了年轻时喝过的真正的龙舌兰果汁。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
It wasn't factory-made powder. Real agave juice took so much time and effort to make that we only drank it on special occasions.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
那不是工厂生产的粉末。真正的龙舌兰果汁制作起来非常耗时费力，所以我们只在特殊的场合才会喝。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
On those days, my whole family would gather around and make agave juice together. We'd also grill steaks wrapped in agave leaves, and sometimes relatives from far away would also visit us to play music and dance together all night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
在那样的日子里，全家人都会聚在一起制作龙舌兰果汁。我们还会用龙舌兰叶子包裹牛排进行烧烤，有时远房亲戚也会来拜访，大家一起唱歌跳舞直到深夜。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I had so much fun as a child, but my child never got to experience any of that. Nowadays, everyone's just too busy to gather or stay up all night, singing and dancing.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我小时候过得很快乐，但我的孩子从未体验过那样的生活。如今，大家都太忙了，没有时间去聚会，也没有时间彻夜歌唱和舞蹈。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But we Cacti want to preserve our traditions as best we can, to teach them to our children.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
但我们仙人掌族希望能尽可能保留这些传统，并将它们传授给我们的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Ah, I've talked too much. I'm sorry I took up your time, Adventurer.
Thank you. Please take this. It's not much, but I hope you'll like it.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
啊，我说了太多话。抱歉占用了您的时间，冒险者。
谢谢您。请收下这个。虽然不多，但我希望您会喜欢。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
And if you're not busy, could you come back and hunt some more coyotes? There've been more coyotes lately than before. They're part of nature, just like we are, but they're threatening our safety.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
如果您不忙的话，能回来再帮我猎杀一些寇犹铁吗？最近寇犹铁比以前更多了。它们也是自然界的一部分，就像我们一样，但它们正在威胁我们的安全。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I may not be able to give my son real agave juice, but I at least want to be able to go buy things he wants.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我可能无法给我的儿子真正的龙舌兰果汁，但我至少希望能有能力买到他想要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I'll appreciate if you can help me every day, starting from today.
I'll really appreciate if you can help for a little longer. You inspire me to try harder to make a better life for my son.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
如果您能从今天开始，每天都帮帮我，我会非常感激。
如果您能再多坚持一段时间，我会更加感激。您激励着我更努力地生活，为我的儿子创造更好的未来。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You need to stop what you're doing and look at it sometimes, or you'll miss important details.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
有时候你需要停下手中的工作，抬头看看周围，否则你会错过重要的细节。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, I'm grateful for your help, but you need to come back in the morning. Thanks.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
一如既往，我很感激您的帮助，但您需要明天早上再来。谢谢。

scripts.text:
Strange Adventurer, thank you for coming back.
You came to hunt coyotes for me, right?
scripts.translation:
奇怪的冒险者，谢谢你回来。
你是来帮我猎杀寇犹铁的吧？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No, I came to talk.
scripts.translation: 不，我是来聊天的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You're not as busy as usual, huh?
I'm not too busy myself either, thanks to you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
你看起来不像平时那么忙啊。
多亏了你，我自己也不太忙了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
Having something to do is a blessing.
We wake up in the morning, work to repay nature's gifts, and go to bed at night.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
有事可做是一种福气。
我们早上醒来，工作以回报自然的馈赠，晚上睡觉。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But of course, you need time to rest, like now. Working all day and not resting makes one's life dull.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
但当然，你也需要休息的时间，就像现在这样。整天工作而不休息，生活会变得枯燥乏味。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
As always, please hunt ^0000CD30 Coyotes^000000 for me.
Every night, they show up in groups, yipping as if to say we'd never be able to get rid of all of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
一如既往，请帮我猎杀^0000CD30只寇犹铁^000000。
每天晚上，它们成群结队地出现，叽叽喳喳地叫，好像在说我们永远也消灭不完它们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
But I believe one small change a day can eventually make a huge difference.
And you're making it possible. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
但我相信，每天的一点小改变，最终能带来巨大的不同。
而你正在让这一切成为可能。谢谢你。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
I asked you to hunt 30 Coyotes. How many did you hunt?
If you're tired, get some rest first. I don't want to burden you with my request.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
我让你去猎杀30只寇犹铁。你猎杀了多少只？
如果你累了，就先休息一下吧。我不想因为我的请求而给你增加负担。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
You came back from hunting. I'm not burdening you with this, am I?
Please keep hunting coyotes as often as you can. They'll be just as troublesome to you as they are to us if you plan to visit this place frequently.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
你从狩猎中回来了。我没有给你增加负担吧？
请尽可能多地继续猎杀寇犹铁。如果你打算经常来这个地方，它们对你来说也会和我们一样麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. Cacturon]
This is the best I can do. I hope you'll like it. I'd like to thank you for your help on behalf of my family.
scripts.translation:
[卡克图隆夫人]
这是我所能做的最好的了。希望你能喜欢。
我想代表我的家人感谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
I love agave-flavored juice. I want to drink it every day.
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
我喜欢龙舌兰口味的果汁。我想每天都喝。

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Agave juice? Do you mean my favorite agave-flavored juice?
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
龙舌兰果汁？你是说我最喜欢的那种龙舌兰口味果汁吗？

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Mom said she'd bring me agave-flavored juice. My agave-flavored juice...
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
妈妈说她会给我带龙舌兰口味的果汁。我的龙舌兰口味果汁...

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Wah! WAH! My agave-flavored juice!
*Sniffle* How many days do I have to wait to get my agave-flavored juice? Lecter doesn't want to wa... wait... BOOHOO!
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
哇！哇！我的龙舌兰口味果汁！
*抽泣* 我还要等多少天才能喝到龙舌兰口味果汁？莱克特不想等...等...呜呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Wah! WAH! My agave-flavored juice!
*Sniffle* How many days do I have to wait to get my agave-flavored juice? Lecter doesn't want to wa... wait... BOOHOO!
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
哇！哇！我的龙舌兰口味果汁！
*抽泣* 我还要等多少天才能喝到龙舌兰口味果汁？莱克特不想等...等...呜呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Little Lecter]
Whoa, agave-flavored juice! Thank you, Adventurer!
Could you talk to my mom? I can't drink it until she says I can.
scripts.translation:
[小 莱克特]
哇，龙舌兰口味果汁！谢谢你，冒险者！
你能帮我跟妈妈说说吗？在她允许之前，我不能喝。

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand, but I'm carrying too much to examine it. I'd better lighten my bag first. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里，但我身上带的东西太多，没法检查它。我最好先减轻一下背包的重量。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. I think it's just trash. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。我觉得它只是垃圾。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. It could be Mrs. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。这可能是卡克图隆夫人的龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

scripts.text: - I moved close and picked up the pouch. It has the juice mix brand logo on it. Fortunately, it's not torn. -
scripts.translation: - 我走近捡起布袋。上面有果汁混合品牌的标志。幸运的是，它没有破损。 -

scripts.text: - I shook the sand off the pouch and put it in my bag. -
scripts.translation: - 我抖掉布袋上的沙子，把它放进了包里。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even Mrs. Cacturon doesn't think she could get all seven packages back.
This should be enough. I'd better end; to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得她可能无法找回全部七个袋子。
这应该足够了。我最好结束了；去村庄并向她汇报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right? I also need to hunt 30 Coyotes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了？我还需要猎杀30只寇犹铁。

scripts.text: - There's something weird about this mound of sand, but but I'm carrying too much to examine it. I'd better lighten my bag first. -
scripts.translation: - 这个沙堆有点奇怪，但我身上带的东西太多，没法检查它。我最好先减轻一下背包的重量。 -

scripts.text: - Someone must have piled this mound of sand. -
scripts.translation: - 一定是有人堆了这个沙堆。 -

scripts.text: - A tattered fabric pouch is half buried in the mound of sand. It could be Mrs. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一个破旧的布袋半埋在沙堆里。这可能是卡克图隆夫人的龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

scripts.text: - I moved close and picked up the pouch. It has the juice mix brand logo on it. Fortunately, it's not torn. -
scripts.translation: - 我走近捡起布袋。上面有果汁混合品牌的标志。幸运的是，它没有破损。 -

scripts.text: - I shook the sand off the pouch and put it in my bag. -
scripts.translation: - 我抖掉布袋上的沙子，把它放进了包里。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even Mrs. Cacturon doesn't think she could get all seven packages back.
This should be enough. I'd better end; to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得她可能无法找回全部七个袋子。
这应该足够了。我最好结束了；去村庄并向她汇报。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, right? I also need to hunt 30 Coyotes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了？我还需要猎杀30只寇犹铁。

scripts.text: - I picked up the pouch. Sweet-smelling powder started pouring out through the tears at the bottom. -
scripts.translation: - 我捡起布袋。底部破洞处开始流出香甜的粉末。 -

scripts.text: - It's not usable. I'll just have to leave it and look for another one. -
scripts.translation: - 它不能用了。我只能把它留在这里，去找另一个。 -

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
It seems all strangers are greedy, and you're not an exception.
Why are you carrying so much?
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
看来所有陌生人都很贪婪，你也不例外。
你为什么带这么多东西？

scripts.text: - I'd better lighten my bag and talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好减轻一下背包的重量，再和他谈谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Why, haven't you seen a Cactus in this wasteland before? I'm busy. Go on your way.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
怎么，你以前没见过荒原里的仙人掌吗？我很忙。请回吧。

scripts.text: Ask if he's seen a juice mix package.
scripts.translation: 询问他是否见过龙舌兰口味果汁袋。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Have you seen some juice mix packages around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在这附近见过龙舌兰口味果汁袋吗？

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Juice mix package? If you're talking about the package I found stuck in between rocks, then yes, I have.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
龙舌兰口味果汁袋？如果你说的是我夹在岩石间找到的那个袋子，那么是的，我有。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
It's Mrs. Cacturon's. Let me bring it back to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那是卡克图隆夫人的。让我把它还给她吧。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
No. Why would I give you something Cacturon has lost?
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
不。我为什么要给你卡克图隆丢失的东西？

scripts.text: Threaten him.
scripts.translation: 威胁他

scripts.text: Persuade him.
scripts.translation: 劝说他。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm here on her behalf. If you keep being stubborn,
then I'll have to use force.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是代表她来的。如果你继续固执己见，
那我只能动武了。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Blood will have blood, and I don't want that. You can have the package, stranger.
But Cacturon should be ashamed of herself for trusting thugs like you.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
血债血偿，我可不想那样。你可以拿走那个袋子，陌生人。
但卡克图隆应该为自己信任像你这样的恶棍而感到羞愧。

scripts.text: - I've got the juice mix package, but I feel bad that I threatened him to get them. -
scripts.translation: - 我拿到了龙舌兰口味果汁袋，但我觉得威胁他拿到它让我很内疚。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've been looking for some juice mix packages because I know someone has lost them.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我一直在寻找一些龙舌兰口味果汁袋，因为我知道有人弄丢了它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
And this one of them, and it doesn't belong to you.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
这是其中之一，而且它不属于你。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
You're right. It doesn't belong to me.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
你说得对。它不属于我。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Then why don't you let me bring it back to its owner? Mrs. Cacturon's child is upset because he can't have his favorite juice. I only want him to be happy.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
那你为什么不让我把它还给主人呢？卡克图隆夫人的孩子因为喝不到他最喜欢的果汁而很难过。我只是想让他开心。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Mm... Your logic isn't completely flawless, but at least it proves that you know Cacturon and Lecter.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
嗯...你的逻辑并不完美，但至少证明你认识卡克图隆和莱克特。

scripts.text:
[Wasteland Cactuten]
Okay, I'll give it to you. But if I find out you lied to me, I'll see that you pay for betraying a Cactus's trust.
scripts.translation:
[荒原仙人掌]
好吧，我把它给你。但如果我发现你骗了我，我会让你为背叛仙人掌的信任付出代价。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I swear I'm not lying.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我发誓我没有说谎。

scripts.text: - I've got the juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 我拿到了龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Even Mrs. Cacturon doesn't think she could get all seven packages back.
This should be enough. I'd better return to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得她可能无法找回全部七个袋子。
这应该足够了。我最好回村庄并向她汇报。

scripts.translation:
[{0}]

scripts.translation:

怎么，你以前没见过荒原里的仙人掌吗？我很忙。请回吧。

scripts.text: - A coyote has something in its mouth and it's shaking its head, playing with the thing. But I'm carrying too much to check what it has in its mouth. I'd better lighten my bag first. -
scripts.translation: - 一只郊狼嘴里叼着什么东西，正摇着头玩耍。但我身上带的东西太多，没法检查它嘴里叼的是什么。我最好先减轻一下负重。 -

scripts.text: - A coyote has something in its mouth and it's shaking its head, playing with the thing. It could be Mrs. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一只郊狼嘴里叼着什么东西，正摇着头玩耍。那可能是卡克图隆夫人的龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

scripts.text: - Maybe I should yell and scare it away. What should I yell? -
scripts.translation: - 也许我该大喊一声把它吓跑。我该喊什么呢？ -

scripts.text:
[{0}]
*Clear throat* {1}!

[Curious Coyote]
YIP!
scripts.translation:
[好奇的郊狼]
咿！

scripts.text: - Startled, the coyote scuttled backward. I moved close to check what it dropped. It's a juice mix package! -
scripts.translation: - 郊狼被吓了一跳，向后缩去。我走近查看它掉落的东西。是龙舌兰口味果汁袋！ -

This should be enough. I'd better return to the village and report to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
连卡克图隆夫人都觉得她可能无法找回全部七个袋子。
这应该足够了。我最好回村庄并向她汇报。

哦，对了？我还需要猎杀30只寇犹铁。

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
Stranger...
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
陌生人...

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
You're obsessed with materials. Don't you know they only weigh you down?
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
你太执着于材料了。难道你不知道它们只会拖累你吗？

scripts.text: - I'd better lighten my bag and talk to him again. -
scripts.translation: - 我最好减轻一下背包的重量，再和他谈谈。 -

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
Stranger...
Don't come near me, or else.
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
陌生人...
别靠近我，否则后果自负。

scripts.text: Have you seen some juice mix packages?
scripts.translation: 你见过龙舌兰口味果汁袋吗？

scripts.text:

Have you seen some juice mix packages around here?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你在这附近见过龙舌兰口味果汁袋吗？

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
Juice mix package?
...Are you looking for this? I've found it buried in the sand.
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
龙舌兰口味果汁袋？
...你在找这个吗？我在沙子里挖到了它。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
That's it. Mrs. Cacturon has lost it. Let me bring it back to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
就是这个。卡克图隆夫人弄丢了它。让我把它带回去给她。

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
...
...I see.
You said Mrs. Cacturon has lost it. Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
...
...我明白了。
你说卡克图隆夫人弄丢了它。你是谁？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm an adventurer, and I'm here on her behalf.
If you don't believe me, then you can go to the village and talk to her.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我是冒险者，受她委托而来。
如果你不信，可以去村庄找她核实。

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
*Snort* Do you think I'm stupid? If you're a thief, you wouldn't be here by the time I come back from the village.
Here, take it.
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
*哼* 你以为我很傻吗？如果你是盗贼，等我回到村庄时你早就跑了。
拿着吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you just going to give it to me?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你就这么直接给我了？

scripts.text:
[Cactus Girl]
You said Mrs. Cacturon sent you, and I trust her. Why, do you want me to give you a hard time?
scripts.translation:
[仙人掌女孩]
你说卡克图隆夫人派你来的，我相信她。干嘛，你想让我为难你吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No. Thank you for giving it to me.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
不。谢谢你把它给我。

scripts.text: - I've received the juice mix package from the Cactus girl. -
scripts.translation: - 我从仙人掌女孩那里收到了龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

Stranger...

scripts.translation:

陌生人...
别靠近我，否则后果自负。

scripts.translation: - 一只郊狼嘴里叼着什么东西，正摇着头玩耍。但我身上带的东西太多，没法检查它嘴里叼的是什么。我最好先减轻一下负重。 -

scripts.text: - A coyote is so absorbed in playing with something in its mouth that it doesn't know I'm near. Maybe it has Mr. Cacturon's juice mix package. -
scripts.translation: - 一只郊狼正全神贯注地玩弄嘴里的东西，完全没注意到我靠近。也许它叼着卡克图隆先生的龙舌兰口味果汁袋。 -

scripts.text: - Maybe I should yell and scare it away. What should I yell? -
scripts.translation: - 也许我该大喊一声把它吓跑。我该喊什么呢？ -

*Inhale deeply* {1}!

[Absorbed Coyote]
YIP!
scripts.translation:
[出神的郊狼]
咿！

scripts.translation: - 郊狼被吓了一跳，向后缩去。我走近查看它掉落的东西。是龙舌兰口味果汁袋！ -

Oh, right? I also need to hunt 30 Coyotes.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，对了？我还需要猎杀30只寇犹铁。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hello.
May the sun and earth
bless you.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
你好。
愿太阳与大地
保佑你。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You're one of those strangers from a far land.
I'm Crouched Horse,
a brave warrior of the Cacti.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
你是来自远方的陌生人之一。
我是蜷伏的马，
仙人掌族的勇士。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Ah, you're back.
Did you find the ore fragments I asked?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
啊，你回来了。
你找到我需要的矿石碎片了吗？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
For now,
I don't need more ores.
But I will
when the sun comes up tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
暂时，
我不需要更多矿石了。
但明天
太阳升起时我会需要。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Ah, it's you.
I'm running out of
the ores.
Say, could you
help me again?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
啊，是你。
我的矿石快用完了。
那个，你能
再帮我一次吗？

scripts.text: [Crouched Horse]
scripts.translation: [蜷伏的马]

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Not everything in your village
has settled.
There's a time for everything.
Go back and
help your village get settled first.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
你们村庄的一切
还没有安定下来。
凡事皆有定时。
先回去
帮助你的村庄安定下来吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
You've resolved
one of the greatest challenges your village faced.
I applaud you for your bravery and wisdom.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
你解决了
你们村庄面临的最大挑战之一。
我敬佩你的勇气与智慧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you're not busy,
could you also help my village?
It's not difficult.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
如果你不忙的话，
能也帮帮我的村庄吗？
这并不难。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 我能为你做什么？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
This place
has been
our home
for many,
many generations.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
这个地方
已经是我们
许多、
许多代人的家园了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
And for a long time,
we lived in harmony with nature.
Then a few years ago
you came from a far land.
Your way of life
was different from ours.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
很长一段时间以来，
我们与自然和谐共处。
直到几年前，
你们从远方而来。
你们的生活方式
与我们的不同。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
We repay Nature
for her gifts,
and we don't take
more than we need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
我们回报自然
给予我们的恩赐，
我们不会索取
超过需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
But you do.
You liked to
take more things
than what you need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
但你们会。
你们喜欢
索取比需要的
更多的东西。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Because we're greedy,
- and I'm ashamed of it.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 因为我们贪婪，
- 我为此感到羞愧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
I'm not trying to blame you.
It's just that
you take so much
that there's
nothing left
for us.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
我并不是要责怪你们。
只是你们
索取太多，
以至于
留给我们
的所剩无几。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- What do you need?
- How can I help?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 你们需要什么？
- 我该如何帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
If you find purple ore fragments
while exploring this land,
I'd like you to
bring them to me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
如果你在探索这片土地时
发现了紫罗兰矿石碎片，
我希望你能
把它们带给我。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Since you opened the mine,
we've been having a hard time
finding the ores.
Say, can you do that?
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
自从你们开采了矿场，
我们就很难找到矿石了。
请问，你能帮我们做这件事吗？

scripts.text: Mm, not now.
scripts.translation: 嗯，现在不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. I'll be right back.
scripts.translation: 没问题。我马上回来。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
You can come back when you're not busy.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...我理解。
等你不忙的时候再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You can find
purple ore fragments
while hunting in this area.
Just bring me 10. That's all I need.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
哦，谢谢你！
你可以在这个区域狩猎时
找到紫罗兰矿石碎片。
只要带给我10个就够了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Thank you.
May the sun and earth bless you!
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
谢谢。
愿太阳和大地保佑你！

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you don't have
all of them.
You can find them
from coyotes
and the Buffalo Bandits.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
嗯，你还没有
集齐所有碎片。
你可以从寇犹铁
和野牛强盗身上找到它们。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Yes, I did.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 是的，我做到了。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
I don't feel good about
having to sacrifice
others
for my own sake.
Thank you for doing this for me.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
为了我自己的利益
而牺牲他人，
让我感到很不舒服。
谢谢你为我做了这件事。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Please take this small token of my appreciation.
I've received it from your village,
and I don't need it.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
请收下这份小小的心意。
这是我从你们村庄那里得到的，
我不需要它。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Hm, you've brought
more than
I asked.
I know you mean well,
but I don't need so many.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
嗯，你带来的
比我要求的
还要多。
我知道你是好意，
但我不需要这么多。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Next time,
please just bring
as many as I ask.
But thanks.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
下次，
请只带
我要求数量的矿石。
不过还是谢谢了。

scripts.text: Not this time.
scripts.translation: 这次不行。

scripts.text: Sure thing. It'd be my pleasure.
scripts.translation: 没问题。我很乐意。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, I see.
Hm... I understand.
Feel free to come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
哦，我明白了。
嗯...我理解。
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Crouched Horse]
Oh, thank you!
You're as reliable as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[蜷伏的马]
哦，谢谢你！
你果然像我想象的那样可靠。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Oh, I close today. Come back tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
哦，我今天打烊了。明天再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Nice to meet you.
I'm Abraham Iven Hudin. I'm originally from different country.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
很高兴见到你。
我是亚伯拉罕·伊文·胡丁。我来自另一个国家。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
So you have things that I might have interest in on buying?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
所以，你有我可能感兴趣购买的东西吗？

scripts.text: What kinds of things?
scripts.translation: 什么样的东西？

scripts.text: I'm not selling anything!
scripts.translation: 我不卖任何东西！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Whoa, whoa! Adventurer is violent. I not do business with barbarians.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
哎呀，哎呀！这位冒险者好凶啊。我不跟野蛮人做生意。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I travels the world and bought valuable things. This time I collecting specialty products of this new continent.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
我游历世界，购买珍贵的物品。这次，我正在收集这个新大陆的特色产品。

scripts.text: (I can barely understand his English.)
scripts.translation: （我几乎听不懂他的英语。）

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? What have you said?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯？你刚才说什么？

scripts.text: Nothing. Go on.
scripts.translation: 没什么。请继续。

scripts.text: I said I can't understand what you're saying.
scripts.translation: 我说我听不懂你在说什么。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Adventurer have a cold heart!
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
这位冒险者好冷漠啊！

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Anyway, I looking for things that can only find in this place. If you found them, gimme them.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
总之，我在找只有这里才有的东西。如果你找到了，就卖给我吧。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
I'll pay you good. You welcomes all the time.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
我会给你很好的价格。随时欢迎你来。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
What have you brought my today?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
你今天给我带来了什么？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm, do you want your things back?
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯，你想把东西拿回去吗？

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
Mm? Where are they? The things you said will give me.
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
嗯？东西呢？你说过要给我的那些东西。

scripts.text:
[Exotic Merchant]
It good business. These I didn't see anywhere else. I like them very much!
scripts.translation:
[异域商人]
这笔买卖不错。我在别处都没见过这些。我很喜欢！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I don't have enough food for you!
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
什么？我没有足够的食物给你！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Hey, don't you see the line over there? I don't care who you are? go stand in line if you want to eat.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
嘿，你没看到那边的队伍吗？不管你是谁，想吃就给我去排队。

scripts.text: I'm not here to eat.
scripts.translation: 我不是来吃饭的。

scripts.text: I'll stand in line.
scripts.translation: 我去排队。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
*Snort* You'd better.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
*哼* 你最好这么做。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You're not here to eat. Err, is that...? Ah, my apologies.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
你不是来吃饭的。呃，那是...？啊，抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Wait, then why are you bothering me? Can't you see I'm upset because of the missing shipment?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
等等，那你来找我干嘛？难道你没看到我因为货物丢失而心烦意乱吗？

scripts.text: What missing shipment?
scripts.translation: 什么货物丢失了？

scripts.text: That's your business.
scripts.translation: 那是你的事。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
啧，你真是个混蛋。我没时间跟你废话。快滚！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Look at that. Those people have been waiting for their food for hours. How can I tell them that I don't have enough ingredients to cook for them?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
你看那些人。他们已经等了好几个小时了。我该怎么告诉他们，我没有足够的食材来给他们做饭呢？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The food ingredients that were supposed to come from Midgard didn't arrive, and I can't keep these people waiting.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
本来应该从米德加尔特送来的食材没有到，我不能让这些人一直等下去。

scripts.text: Why don't you procure some ingredients from the outside?
scripts.translation: 你为什么不从外面采购一些食材？

scripts.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Good luck.
scripts.translation: 听到这个很遗憾。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
啧，你真是个混蛋。我没时间跟你废话。快滚！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I thought about it. I was desperate enough to try anything.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
我考虑过了。我当时走投无路，什么办法都试了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
But there are only sand and rocks out there, and nothing edible. I can't believe I thought I could run a kitchen in a place like this.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
但外面只有沙子和岩石，没有任何可吃的东西。我真不敢相信我竟然想过在这种地方开厨房。

scripts.text:
[Hungry Laborer]
^990000Wait, did you just say you have no ingredients? You ran out of them?^000000
scripts.translation:
[饥饿的劳工]
^990000等等，你刚才说没有食材了吗？你用完它们了？^000000

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
^990000No, I didn't say that! It's just taking a little longer to cook today. Stop panicking!^000000
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
^990000不，我没这么说！只是今天做饭需要的时间稍微长一点。别惊慌！^000000

scripts.text: I can help.
scripts.translation: 我可以帮忙。

scripts.text: Good luck.
scripts.translation: 祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Grr, you're a jerk. I don't have time for this. Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
啧，你真是个混蛋。我没时间跟你废话。快滚！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
You can help. How?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
你可以帮忙。怎么帮？

scripts.text: You need food ingredients, don't you?
scripts.translation: 你需要食材，对吧？

scripts.text: That depends on you.
scripts.translation: 那得看你。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Alright, then let's do this. I'll jot down everything I need. Can you bring them from Midgard?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
好吧，那就这么办。我会把需要的东西都记下来。你能从米德加尔特把它们带过来吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: It'd be a waste of my time if I say no now.
scripts.translation: 现在说“不”就太浪费我的时间了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Good! We've made a deal. I need some time to take inventory. Talk to me again later.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
很好！我们成交了。我需要一点时间清点库存。稍后再来找我。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
今天这些应该就够了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Aww, here's the list of ingredients I need. Bring them quickly, will you?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
哎呀，这是我需要的食材清单。请快点把它们带过来，好吗？

scripts.text: Sure thing.
scripts.translation: 没问题。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Oh, come on. Help me out here. People are starving.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
拜托了，帮个忙吧。大家都快饿死了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Sweet potato croquettes are on the menu today, and I can't make them because I didn't get the regular shipment from the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
今天的菜单是红薯可乐饼，但我没收到来自大陆的常规货物，做不了。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
There are so many mouths to feed, and yet I've got no meat? This is disaster!
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
这么多人要吃饭，我却一点肉都没有？这可糟了！

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
What? I could always feed them veggies, you say? Sure, but all they want is meat.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
什么？你说我可以喂他们蔬菜？当然可以，但他们只想要肉。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 50 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带50个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Have you seen the carrots growing in the garden in the back?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
你看到后面花园里种的胡萝卜了吗？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
They're as thin as fingers, and once I almost put my fingers into a stew instead of them.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
它们细得像手指，有一次我差点把手指放进炖汤里，而不是胡萝卜。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I shouldn't have put that banana bread on the menu. Who knew they wouldn't arrive in time?
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
我不该把香蕉面包列入菜单的。谁知道它们会迟到呢？

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
I have to cook a pumpkin stew, but I don't have pumpkins. This is the equivalent of making toast without bread.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
我得做南瓜汤，但我没有南瓜。这就像没有面包却要做吐司一样。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 160 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带160个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
The only thing I can cook with the ingredients I have is mushroom soup, but I don't have the main ingredient: mushrooms.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
用我现有的食材，只能做蘑菇汤，但我没有主要食材：蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me 60 {0} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带60个{0}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Bring me {0} {1} from Midgard. You can buy them from merchants in big cities.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
请从米德加尔特给我带{0}个{1}。你可以在大城市的商人那里买到。

scripts.text:
[Food Distributer]
Whew, thank you. This should be enough for the day today.
scripts.translation:
[食物分发员]
呼，谢谢你。今天这些应该就够了。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Sorry, but we need someone stronger than you.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
抱歉，我们需要比你更强壮的人。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hey, buddy. You look pretty strong. You're here to work, right?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
嘿，伙计。你看起来挺强壮的。你是来工作的吧？

scripts.text: No. I'm just a tourist.
scripts.translation: 不，我只是个游客。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Come on, don't be so heartless. I'm trying to strike up a conversation here. I've got a proposition that you might be interested. What do you say?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
拜托，别这么无情嘛。我只是想搭个话。我有个提议，你可能会感兴趣。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Alright, let me hear it.
scripts.translation: 好吧，让我听听。

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Oh, you don't. *Smacks his lips* How disappointing!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哦，你不感兴趣。*咂了咂嘴* 真让人失望！

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, so you're not as snobbish as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
啊，看来你并没有我想象中那么势利。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
For Rock Ridge to become a transport hub, the monsters that live around it have got to go, but we can't find the right people for the job.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
为了让洛克理奇成为交通枢纽，必须清除周围居住的魔物，但我们找不到合适的人手。

scripts.text: What about all these people?
scripts.translation: 那这些人呢？

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
*Snort* These? Yeah, we thought they were good enough until we realized how strong the monsters out there were.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
*哼* 这些人？是啊，我们本来以为他们够格，直到发现外面的魔物有多强。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
None of these guys would come back alive, let alone earn their keep. And then we'd have to go out there to collect their remains, which is doubly bad for us.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这些人没有一个能活着回来，更别提能胜任工作了。然后我们还得出门去收尸，这对我们来说更是雪上加霜。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Then I saw you, and you stood out like a wolf among sheep. That is, you've passed! Congratulations!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
然后我看到了你，你就像羊群中的狼一样出众。也就是说，你通过了！恭喜！

scripts.text: I never said I wanted to work with you.
scripts.translation: 我可没说想跟你合作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Ah, come on, don't be like that. Help this poor man out here.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哎呀，别这样嘛。帮帮这个可怜人吧。

scripts.text: Okay.
scripts.translation: 好的。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Okay, okay, I understand if you're busy. But I'm offering you benefits both of us.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
好吧好吧，我理解你很忙。但我提供的待遇对双方都有好处。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
How about I show you the list of things you could do for us? If you're interested, come back later. I promise I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这样吧，我让你看看你可以为我们做哪些事。如果你感兴趣，稍后再来找我。我保证会给你丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The worst is over. I'll need your help again. Save your energy until then, alright?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
最糟糕的时期已经过去了。之后我还需要你的帮助。在那之前，请保存好你的体力，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你忘了你要做什么了吗？那么，我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这里周围田野里最大的威胁是野牛强盗。他们聪明且残忍，不听任何道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
而且他们时不时地入侵这个村庄，仿佛在试探我们能坚持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits with rifles^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我们想杀鸡儆猴，让他们收敛点。消灭^0000ff15持有步枪的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这里周围田野里最大的威胁是野牛强盗。他们聪明且残忍，不听任何道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
而且他们时不时地入侵这个村庄，仿佛在试探我们能坚持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits wearing red masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我们想杀鸡儆猴，让他们收敛点。消灭^0000ff15戴着红色面具的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The biggest threat in the fields around here is the Buffalo Bandits. They're smart and ruthless, and they won't listen to reason.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
这里周围田野里最大的威胁是野牛强盗。他们聪明且残忍，不听任何道理。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
And they've been invading this village every so often, as if to test how long we could last.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
而且他们时不时地入侵这个村庄，仿佛在试探我们能坚持多久。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
We want to set an example and keep them in check. Get rid of ^0000ff15 Buffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我们想杀鸡儆猴，让他们收敛点。消灭^0000ff15戴着独眼龙眼罩的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你忘了你要做什么了吗？那么，我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The Cacti and the members of this village are on good terms, and recently more coyotes have been seen along the road that leads to their village.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
仙人掌和这个村庄的成员关系很好，但最近通往他们村庄的路上出现了越来越多的寇犹铁。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Coyotes aren't aggressive, but they still keep the Cacti from coming in and out of their village freely.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
寇犹铁虽然不具攻击性，但它们仍然阻碍着仙人掌自由进出村庄。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt ^0000ff20 Coyotes^000000 and help our friends.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
请狩猎^0000ff20寇犹铁^000000，帮助我们的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The workers who were sent down to the basement of the village went missing one after another, so we investigated. We believe they were killed by monsters.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
派往村庄地下的工人接连失踪，我们对此进行了调查。我们认为他们是死于魔物之手。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Swamp Arclouzes are fast, carnivorous insects living down there, and their number has been increasing at such an alarming rate that workers now refuse to go in there to work.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
沼泽卷甲虫是生活在那里的快速肉食性昆虫，它们的数量正以惊人的速度增长，工人们现在都拒绝进去工作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business down there, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffSwamp Arclouzes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
如果你要去那里办事，请消灭10只^0000ff沼泽卷甲虫^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
The bodies of the workers who went missing in the basement have been found. They were mangled so badly that even their families had a hard time recognizing them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
在地下失踪的工人的尸体已经被找到了。他们被撕咬得面目全非，连家人都很难辨认出来。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
I think they were killed by brown rats that thrive in the basement. Rumor has it they even attack living people, and if it holds true, that's serious.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
我想他们是死于在地下繁衍生息的沼泽蓝鼠。传闻它们甚至会攻击活人，如果这是真的，那就很严重了。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
If you have business in the basement, please exterminate 10 ^0000ffBrown Rats^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
如果你要去地下办事，请消灭10只^0000ff沼泽蓝鼠^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're amazing? I didn't know you could really do this! Thanks!
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你太厉害了！我不知道你真的能做到！谢谢！

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Hah hah, thank you for your interest, but we're not desperate enough to need help from little kids like you.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
哈哈，谢谢你的好意，但我们还没到需要像你这样的小孩帮忙的地步。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou must be Level 140 or above to receive this quest.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你必须达到140级才能接受这个任务。^000000

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Mm? You're not one of us. If you need a job, then you should look elsewhere.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
嗯？你不是我们的人。如果你需要工作，应该去别处找找。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你很棒。我很乐意再次与你合作。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're pretty strong. Can you handle something tough?
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你很强。你能处理一些棘手的事情吗？

scripts.text: Sure, why not?
scripts.translation: 当然，为什么不呢？

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
好的，请慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Did you forget what you have to do? Then, I'll tell you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你忘了你要做什么了吗？那么，我再告诉你一次。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
[菁英]巡逻牛仔是野牛强盗中的首领，这次的任务就是关于他们的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with rifles before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those with ^0000ffglowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前用步枪对付过野牛强盗，对吧？那你一定见过那些^0000ff眼睛发着蓝光^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of rifle buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffrifle Buffalo Bandits with glowing blue eyes^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
它们是持枪野牛强盗的中层军官。我要你消灭10只^0000ff眼睛发着蓝光的持枪野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
[菁英]巡逻牛仔是野牛强盗中的首领，这次的任务就是关于他们的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the masked buffaloes before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffgreen masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前对付过戴面具的野牛强盗，对吧？那你一定见过那些戴着^0000ff绿色面具^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of masked buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing green masks^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
它们是戴面具野牛强盗的中层军官。我要你消灭10只^0000ff戴着绿色面具的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Elite Buffalo Bandits are leaders among the Buffalo Bandits, and this is about them.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
[菁英]巡逻牛仔是野牛强盗中的首领，这次的任务就是关于他们的。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You've dealt with the buffaloes with an eye patch before, haven't you? Then you must have seen those wearing ^0000ffpale green vests^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你之前对付过戴独眼龙眼罩的野牛强盗，对吧？那你一定见过那些穿着^0000ff浅绿色背心^000000的家伙。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're the middle-ranking officers of sword buffaloes. I want you to get rid of 10 ^0000ffBuffalo Bandits wearing an eye patch and a pale green vest^000000.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
它们是持剑野牛强盗的中层军官。我要你消灭10只^0000ff戴着独眼龙眼罩和浅绿色背心的野牛强盗^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Some miners have reported to us about gas-like monsters that spread a neurotoxin.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
有矿工向我们报告，说有一种散发神经毒素的瓦斯状魔物。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
They're purple monsters named Gasters. They don't attack unless they're provoked, but they still pose a threat.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
它们是名为瓦斯魔的紫色魔物。除非被挑衅，否则不会主动攻击，但依然具有威胁性。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
Please hunt 10 ^0000ffGasters^000000 in the mine outside the village.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
请在村庄外的矿场讨伐10只^0000ff瓦斯魔^000000。

scripts.text:
[Steel Vigilante]
You're good. I'd love to work with you again.
scripts.translation:
[钢铁义警]
你很棒。我很乐意再次与你合作。

scripts.text: I'm carrying too many types of items. I should lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我携带的物品种类太多了。我应该先减轻背包的重量。

scripts.text: I'm overweight. I'd better lighten my bag first.
scripts.translation: 我超重了。最好先减轻一下背包的重量。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
What are you doing here? You're not good enough to earn your keep. Out!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你在这里做什么？你这种水平连工资都挣不回来。滚出去！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
My office is filled with thieves. Everyone expects to be paid? Without doing their job!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
我的办公室全是小偷。每个人都想拿工资？却不干活！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
And you. How much were you going to ask me for? Just so you know, we don't allow payroll advances.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
还有你。你打算找我要多少钱？告诉你，我们不允许预支工资。

scripts.text: I'm just a passersby.
scripts.translation: 我只是个路人。

scripts.text: I want 100 million Zeny in advance.
scripts.translation: 我想预支1亿Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
...
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
...

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You're out of your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你疯了吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Mm? But you look too strong to be a simple passersby.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
嗯？但你看起来太强了，不像是个普通的路人。

scripts.text: Well, I don't have any business here. I should go.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我没什么事。我该走了。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
WAIT!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Wait. Yes.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
等等。是的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, Jamie! How many more workers did you say we need in the culvert?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
嘿，杰米！你说下水道还需要多少工人？

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Since 2 more disappeared yesterday, 15. No one wants to go down there.^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
^000077昨天又消失了2个，所以是15个。没人愿意去那里。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hear that? Our office is severely understaffed.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
听到了吗？我们办公室严重人手不足。

scripts.text: But what about all these people who are eager to work?
scripts.translation: 但是那些急着找工作的人呢？

scripts.text: Not my business.
scripts.translation: 不关我的事。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Hey, come on! I'm not finished!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
嘿，别走啊！我还没说完呢！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
They're eager, all right, but none of them is strong enough to be useful.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
他们确实很积极，但没一个强壮到能派上用场。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We need a lot of people at a construction site. It's... a little bit dangerous down there, but you look like you know how to deal with danger.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
建筑工地需要很多人手。那里...有点危险，但你看起来像是知道如何应对危险的人。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, how'd you like to work for me? I'll pay you generously.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
喂，你愿意为我工作吗？我会给你丰厚的报酬。

scripts.text: Tell me what this job entails.
scripts.translation: 告诉我这份工作的具体内容。

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You don't have to think! This benefits both of us!
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
不用想那么多！这对我们双方都有利！

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
让我给你介绍一下这个村庄。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遗迹之上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
我们不能完全填满地下室，因为那里安装着我们的海水淡化系统。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Let me tell you a little bit about this village. It's built above the remains of a city that sank into the sea.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
让我给你介绍一下这个村庄。它建在一座沉入海底的城市遗迹之上。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
We can't completely fill up the basement because it's where our desalination system is.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
我们不能完全填满地下室，因为那里安装着我们的海水淡化系统。

scripts.text: Can't you get water elsewhere?
scripts.translation: 不能从别处获取水源吗？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This area is a desert. Desalinating is cheaper than importing water.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
这片区域是沙漠。海水淡化的成本比进口淡水要低。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Anyway, the desalination system itself is in good order, but the cobweb of pipes that forms the system is prone to erosion and breakage. They need constant maintenance.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
总之，海水淡化系统本身运转正常，但构成系统的管道网络容易受到侵蚀和损坏。它们需要持续维护。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Then some time ago, monsters started showing up in the basement, and now our workers are too scared to work. That's the situation we're in right now.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
然后前段时间，地下室开始出现魔物，现在我们的工人吓得不敢工作了。这就是我们目前的状况。

scripts.text: What happens if I say no?
scripts.translation: 如果我拒绝会怎样？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
This village will run out of drinking water. Someone has to do this. Believe it or not, I'm doing doing this entirely for profit.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
这个村庄会断水。总得有人去做这件事。信不信由你，我完全是为了利润才这么做的。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Say, is that good enough motivation for you? If you still don't want to help us, I won't force you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
喂，这理由够充分了吗？如果你还是不想帮我们的忙，我也不会勉强你。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
^000077Mr. Chairman, I've just got a call from the basement. Five more workers have been attacked by monsters.^000000
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
^000077会长先生，我刚接到地下室的电话。又有5名工人被魔物袭击了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Uh-oh, I'd better go take care of that situation. Come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
糟糕，我得去处理一下那里的情况。如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Aren't you tired? The pipes don't need cleaning at this moment. Why don't you go take care of whatever else you have to do?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你不累吗？现在管道不需要清洁。你不妨先去处理其他事情？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Does this mean you're willing to go downstairs?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
这是意味着你愿意去地下室吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Let me think.
scripts.translation: 让我想想。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Alright, take your time.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
好的，慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good. Let me tell you what to do. Take a look at the door at the bottom of the water storage to the left side of me. It's connected to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
很好。让我告诉你该怎么做。看看我左边储水塔底部的那扇门。它连接着地下室。

scripts.text: Do you mean the door that looks like a portal?
scripts.translation: 你是说那扇看起来像传送门的门吗？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Yes. Usually it's closed, and only those who have business in the basement can use it,
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
是的。通常它是关闭的，只有需要在地下室工作的人才能使用。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You know, people who help the Vigilantes, clean the sewer, and maintain the desalination pipes, like you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你知道的，比如帮助义警、清理下水道、维护淡化管道的人，就像你一样。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Your job is to find four different types of pipes and fasten their bolts to prevent leakage.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你的任务是找到四种不同类型的管道，并拧紧它们的螺栓以防止泄漏。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
The pipes that need maintenance are colored differently for easy recognition. When you're ready, enter the door on the left side.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
需要维护的管道颜色不同，以便于识别。准备好了就进入左边的门吧。

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
You haven't finished cleaning the pipes. We'll run out of water soon. Could you hurry up?
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
你还没清理完管道。我们很快就会没水了。能快点吗？

scripts.text:
[Desalination Facility Manager]
Good job. The villagers can enjoy clean water for the rest of the day, and it's all because of you.
scripts.translation:
[海水淡化设施管理员]
干得好。村民们今天剩下的时间都能喝上干净的水，这都多亏了你。

scripts.text:
[Jamie]
Could you stop hitting on me? I'm the Chairman's personal secretary.
scripts.translation:
[杰米]
你能不能别对我动手动脚了？我是会长的私人秘书。

scripts.text: ^0000ffWarning: This place is not for the weak or faint-hearted.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff警告：此地不适合胆小或意志薄弱者。^000000

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to move to the underground village?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你要移动到地下村庄吗？^000000

scripts.text: Move.
scripts.translation: 移动

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the underground passage.
scripts.translation: 你决定不使用地下通道。

scripts.text: ^0000ffDo you want to go above ground?^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你要回到地面吗？^000000

scripts.text: Move.
scripts.translation: 移动

scripts.text: Do it later.
scripts.translation: 稍后再说

scripts.text: You have decided not to use the menu.
scripts.translation: 你决定不使用菜单。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hello.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你好。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You're one of the adventurers from the mainland, right?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你是来自大陆的冒险者之一，对吧？
我叫多诺万，
是下水道系统管理员。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
The pipes are
clear of sea anemones at this moment.
Why don't you
come back later?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
目前管道里
没有沙漠向日葵。
你稍后再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, welcome back!
I've been thinking
it's time to
get rid of sea anemones again.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
啊，欢迎回来！
我一直在想，
是时候
再次清除沙漠向日葵了。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, so you're
the adventurer who took care of the Buffalo Bandits!
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，原来你就是
解决野牛强盗问题的冒险者！
很高兴见到你！

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Go east,
and you'll see Joe.
He'll let you
go down to the basement
if you tell him I sent you.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
往东走，
你会看到乔。
告诉他是我派你来的，
他就会让你去地下室。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Ah, Adventurer, welcome back.
How was it, getting rid of sea anemones?
It wasn't too difficult, was it?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
啊，冒险者，欢迎回来。
清除沙漠向日葵的感觉如何？
应该不太难吧？

scripts.text: [Donovan]
scripts.translation: [多诺万]

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
There are so many problems
the Buffalo Bandits, the mine, just to name a couple?
that no one else cares about their own sewer system right now.
The Buffalo Bandits
need to be taken care of first.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
野牛强盗、米内，光是这两样就够让人头疼了，
现在根本没人顾得上自己的下水道系统。
野牛强盗的问题得先解决。

scripts.text: I can do that.
scripts.translation: 我可以去处理。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，我明白了。
我理解。
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You know how to enter the basement, right?
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你知道怎么进入地下室，对吧？
谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
So, you're strong enough to
take care of the bandits.
Would you be so kind
as to help me with something?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
看来你的实力足以
对付那些强盗。
能请你帮个忙吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- Alright, what can I do for you?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 好的，有什么我可以帮你的？

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, where are my manners?
My name is Donovan,
sewer system manager.
I manage the underground water pump
and sewage system.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哎呀，失礼了。
我叫多诺万，
是下水道系统管理员。
我负责管理地下水泵
和排污系统。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Groundwater keeps welling up
from the basement of the village,
and it has to be pumped out into the sea
to prevent flooding.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
地下水不断从村庄的地下室涌出，
必须将其泵入海中，
以防止洪水泛滥。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
My job is to make sure
the pumps and sewage system are
in working order
at all times,
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
我的工作是确保
水泵和排污系统
始终处于
正常工作状态，

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
and it's not a job for just one man.
There are so many things to do
that I need help.
The work itself isn't complicated.
Could you help me?
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
而且这并非一人之力所能胜任。
要做的事情太多了，
我需要人手。
工作本身并不复杂。
你能帮我吗？

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 当然。

scripts.text: Sorry, I'm busy.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我很忙。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Oh, I see.
I understand.
But come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哦，我明白了。
我理解。
如果你改变主意，随时欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Wow, thank you!
All you have to do is
go down to the basement
and get rid of sea anemones
on the pipes and water pump.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哇，谢谢你！
你只需要
去地下室，
清除管道和水泵上的
沙漠向日葵即可。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
You can go down to the basement
by talking to
Joe, who's a bit east of here.
He'll let you
go down to the basement.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
你可以找乔进入地下室，
他就在东边不远处。
他会让你
进入地下室的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
We call him Quiet Joe.
Thank you for your help.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
我们叫他“沉默的乔”。
谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
- No, it wasn't.
- It was boring, though.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
- 不，不难。
- 不过挺无聊的。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Hah hah, it's a boring job, sure.
But it must not be boring to those sea anemones
because they spring up every day,
no matter how hard I try
to keep them in check.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
哈哈，这工作确实无聊。
但对那些沙漠向日葵来说肯定不无聊，
因为它们每天都冒出来，
无论我多么努力
想要控制它们。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
Getting rid of them
takes up a lot of my time.
Thank you for your help.
I could always use help getting rid of sea anemones.
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[多诺万]
清除它们
占用了我大量的时间。
谢谢你的帮助。
清除沙漠向日葵时，我随时都需要人手。
请再来吧。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What are you looking at? Scram before I put holes in your face! Git!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
看什么看？滚开，不然我打烂你的脸！滚蛋！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I should go. He's just being stubborn.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我该走了。他只是太固执了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Frankly, I don't understand why he would want to do this, but I don't want to stop him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
说实话，我不明白他为什么非要这么做，
但我不想阻止他。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
谢谢你的帮助。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Midnight]
Demon, some strange kid is just hanging out around us. Do you know him?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
恶魔，有个奇怪的小孩一直在我们附近徘徊。
你认识他吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Who? Where? I don't see him. Send him to me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
谁？在哪里？我没看见他。
让他过来找我。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're carrying so much stuff, I'm worried you might break your shoulder. Why don't you go lighten your bag first?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你背了这么多东西，
我担心你会伤到肩膀。
不如先去把包里的东西整理一下？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You're still wet behind the ears. This place is too dangerous for you. Come back later, alright?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你还嫩得很。
这里太危险了，不适合你。
改天再来吧，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You have no idea how dangerous this place is, do you? Get out of here while you can.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你根本不知道这里有多危险，对吧？
趁现在还能走，赶紧离开吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You came back quickly. Ah, I miss being young.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你回来得真快。
啊，真怀念年轻的时候。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But look, I still have left some of the materials you brought me yesterday. I can't use all these.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不过你看，
昨天你带给我的一些材料我还没用完。
我没法一次性用完这么多。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why don't you go home and come back next morning?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不如你先回家，明天早上再来？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo! It's very nice to see you again. The bomb I made with the materials you brought is in the aging process. Did you know wine and bombs get better the older they are?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小家伙！
很高兴再次见到你。
我用你带来的材料做的炸弹正在陈化中。
你知道吧，酒和炸弹都是越陈越好的？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, could you bring some more materials today? We're a long way from having all the bombs we need.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
那么，今天能再带些材料来吗？
我们离凑齐所需的炸弹数量还差得远呢。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
As usual, get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
照旧，去弄 ^0000cd10剧毒粉 和 1 个炸弹粉末^000000，
还有 ^0000cdhunt 15 只瓦斯魔^000000。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我们就指望你了，小家伙！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Alright, this should do. You know what I need, right? Are you sure you could sneak in? Maybe I should go.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
好了，这应该够了。
你知道我需要什么，对吧？
你确定你能潜进去吗？
也许我该亲自去一趟。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll go while everyone's in bed.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
等大家都睡了我就去。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
But the noise could wake them up. There'll be guards, too.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
但动静太大可能会吵醒他们。
而且那里会有卫兵。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I'll be alright. We all look alike? They won't know I'm not one of them.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
没关系的。我们长得都很像，
他们不会发现我不是他们的人。

scripts.text: Mister, what are you doing here?
scripts.translation: 先生，您在这里做什么？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
*Glance*
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
*瞥了一眼*

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why are you playing with fire in the middle of nowhere? You're suspicious.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们为什么在荒郊野外玩火？
你们很可疑。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Hey, a kid is asking you a question. He looks so curious that I'm worried he might die if you don't tell him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，有个小孩在问你问题。
他看起来好奇得要命，
要是你不告诉他，
我怕他会急死。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Little kids like him are full of curiosity. You'd better tell him before he starts crying.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
像他这样的小孩子好奇心都很重。
你最好告诉他，
不然他就要哭了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Yo tell him.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你告诉他吧。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Why should I? He asked you. Plus, kids usually give me heartburn.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不。我为什么要告诉他？
是他问你的。
而且，小孩子通常让我胃疼。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I had my favorite bean dish for breakfast today. I can't lose it. I want it to become part of me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我今天早餐吃了我最爱的豆子料理。
我不能浪费它。
我想让它成为我身体的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Some of it has to come out of you eventually. Poor beans. They'd be angry to be eaten by jerks like you.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
总有一部分迟早要排出来的。
可怜的豆子。
被你们这种混蛋吃掉，
它们肯定会很生气。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, right! Why don't we ask this kid?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哦，对了！
我们何不问问这个小孩？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
What? But we can't trust him? We've just met him!
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
什么？但我们不能信任他吧？
我们才刚认识他！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes, we can. People are supposed to trust each other. You didn't know that, did you? Now that he's here, he's one of us now. And I told you, everyone's born good.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
是的，我们可以信任他。
人与人之间本该互相信任。
你不知道吗？
既然他来了，他就是我们的人了。
而且我告诉过你，
每个人生来都是善良的。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Plus, doesn't he look like he's used to rough things? He has a runner's body and keen eyes that miss nothing. I like kids like him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
而且，他看起来像是个能吃苦的人。
他有一副奔跑者的体格，
还有敏锐的眼睛，
什么都逃不过他的视线。
我喜欢像他这样的孩子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, kiddo. How'd you like to join us in business?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小鬼。
你愿意加入我们一起做生意吗？

scripts.text: What business?
scripts.translation: 什么生意？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You look dangerous. I don't want to do anything dangerous.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你们看起来很危险。
我不想做任何危险的事。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You don't? Alright, then I won't force you. Take care now. This place is dangerous. You'd better get out of here.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
是吗？好吧，那我就不勉强你了。
保重。这里很危险。
你最好赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you sure we can let him go? He's seen us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你确定我们要放他走吗？
他看到我们了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why are you so paranoid? It's okay, kiddo. Just go. But come back if you change your mind!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你为什么这么多疑？
没事的，小鬼。走吧。
但如果你改变主意，记得回来！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
What business?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
什么生意？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We've got a great plan.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我们有个绝妙的主意。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Unless you're going to explain it yourself, just shut up and let me do it!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
除非你自己解释，否则就闭嘴让我来说！

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
That's more like it. Anyway, we're going to rob the ^0000cdmine^000000.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这就对了。总之，我们要去抢劫^0000cd米内^000000。

scripts.text: Rob the mine?
scripts.translation: 抢劫米内？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You didn't have to tell him that. You could've just asked him to get the things for us.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你没必要告诉他这些。
你完全可以让他直接帮我们拿东西。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We can't make him do things for us without explanation. He has the right to know what he's getting himself into.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我们不能不解释就让他做事。
他有权知道自己要卷入什么。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You want to take advantage of a stranger.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你想利用一个陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. I'm asking you to be in on our great plan. Anyway, you know the mine east of here? It used to belong to Gold Moon?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不。我是邀请你参与我们的绝妙计划。
总之，你知道这里东边的米内吗？它以前属于金月？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
So, anyway, the Buffalo Bandits realized how lucrative the mine was and took up residence in there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
所以，总之，野牛强盗们意识到这座米内利润丰厚，就在那里安了家。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I've heard that.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我听说过。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
You have? From where?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你听说过？从哪里听说的？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
At the sheriff's office.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
在警长办公室。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey, did you just get released? So are we! In fact, we've met there. I've met most of my best friends while we were in the system.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，你刚被释放吗？我们也是！
事实上，我们在那里见过面。
我在系统里遇到了我最好的朋友。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I miss the smell of the stone floor. And the coolness.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我怀念石地板的味道。
还有那种凉爽。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I liked the food, too. I hated beans until I went to jail. All the beans I've eaten aren't half as good as those I ate in there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我也喜欢那里的食物。
进监狱前我讨厌豆子。
我吃过的豆子都不如那里的好。

scripts.text: Why did you go to jail?
scripts.translation: 你为什么进监狱？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Oh, that.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哦，那个啊。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Are you going to tell him that too?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你也要告诉他那个吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Why not? I loved that story. You want to hear it, don't you?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
为什么不呢？我喜欢那个故事。
你想听，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I'm really good with my hands, and I like fireworks. What do you think would be the best job for someone like me?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我手很巧，我喜欢烟花。
你觉得像我这样的人最适合做什么工作？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Firecracker maker?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
爆竹制造者？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Close, but I make something stronger: ^0000cdbombs^000000. And mines are just about the best thing that could happen to people like me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
差不多，但我做的更厉害：^0000cd炸弹^000000。而且地雷对我来说简直是天赐之物。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
People working at the mines always need bombs. I came here, hoping I could make some money while doing what I love.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
在矿场工作的人总是需要炸弹。我来这里，希望能一边做自己喜欢的事，一边赚点钱。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
But it didn't work out.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
但事情没办成。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And it's because of you! One night, some guys came to me and said they heard I was a bomb specialist. They demanded I donate bombs to them.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
而且都是因为你！有一天晚上，几个人找到我，说听说我是炸弹专家。他们要求我捐给他们一些炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
One look at them, and I knew they were the infamous ^0000cdBuffalo Bandits^000000. It was obvious why they wanted my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我看了一眼，就知道他们是臭名昭著的^0000cd野牛强盗^000000。他们为什么想要我的炸弹，显而易见。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you still gave them to them.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
而你居然还给了他们。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
What else could I do? A bunch of scary-looking buffaloes who were at least a head taller than me, mind you? Demanded I give them my bombs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我还能怎么办？一群长相凶恶的野牛，而且比我高出一个头，你懂的？他们命令我交出炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
You could've stood?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
你可以站着啊？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No, I couldn't have stood my ground. You weren't there. Anyway, those buffaloes used my bombs to blow up the ore train and take over the mine. Guess what happened to me afterward.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不，我没法抵抗。你当时不在场。总之，那些野牛用我的炸弹炸毁了矿石列车，并占领了矿场。猜猜之后我遭遇了什么。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriff traced the bombs back to me and dragged me with him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
警长追踪炸弹找到了我，把我带走了。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
And you got thrown in jail.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
然后你被扔进了监狱。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And guess who I met there: this guy. He was caught in the explosion that blew up the train, and those heartless buffaloes left him to die.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
猜猜我在那里遇到了谁：这家伙。他在炸毁列车的爆炸中被波及，那些冷血的野牛却弃他于不顾，任其自生自灭。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
And the sheriffs were no better than them. They just left him bleeding all over the cell. What could I do? I couldn't let anyone die if I could help it, so I treated him.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
警长们和他们也没好到哪去。他们只是让他浑身是血地躺在牢房里。我能怎么办？只要力所能及，我不能让任何人死去，所以我给他治了伤。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
He's been following me around since then.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
从那以后，他就一直跟着我。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
Who? Me?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
谁？我？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Yes. Or why did you save me when I came to the mine to get even with the buffaloes? They kicked you out because of me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
是的。不然，当我来矿场找野牛算账时，你为什么要救我？他们因为我的缘故把你赶了出去。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Did you get your revenge after you were released?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你出狱后复仇了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I don't want to talk about it. I made so many stupid mistakes, which wasn't like me at all. That's why we were hiding out in this dark, dank place.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我不想谈那个。我犯了很多愚蠢的错误，这完全不像我。这就是为什么我们躲在这个阴暗潮湿的地方。

scripts.text: So, what can I do to help?
scripts.translation: 那我该怎么做才能帮忙？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Are you sure you want to help? Because I don't like forcing people, or sending them in harm's way. If you really want to help, then you can get some bomb materials for me.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
你确定要帮忙吗？因为我不喜欢强迫别人，也不希望让他们陷入危险。如果你真的想帮忙，那就帮我弄些炸弹材料吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Why, so you could rob the mine?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
为什么，是为了抢劫矿场吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. Technically speaking, we'd ^0000cdreclaim the mine^000000. Have you seen what's going in the village? Since those buffaloes took over the mine, most of the people lost their jobs.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不。严格来说，我们是^0000cd夺回矿场^000000。你看到村庄里的情况了吗？自从那些野牛接管了矿场，大多数人都失业了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Without a job, they can't make money, and without money, they can't feed themselves. This is terrible.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
没有工作，他们就没钱赚；没有钱，他们就没饭吃。这太糟糕了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I want to throw a ^0000cdfirework party inside the mine^000000 and ^0000cdscare away the bandits^000000.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我想在矿场里举办一场^0000cd烟火派对^000000，并^0000cd吓跑那些狸猫^000000。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
But, Mr. Midnight, they used to be your...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
但是，午夜先生，他们曾经是您的...

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Don't worry about him. He cut ties with them a long time ago. He has no love for those buffaloes who abandoned him. Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
别担心他。他早就和他们断绝关系了。他对那些抛弃他的野牛毫无感情。我说得对吗？

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
...

[Demon]
Well, I'll be dipped in buttermilk.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
哎呀，真是让人哭笑不得。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
No, I'm not worried about them, but I am worried about us. If this goes wrong?
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
不，我不是担心他们，而是担心我们。如果计划失败怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The sheriffs will throw us in jail if the bandits don't kill us. But it's okay. I like the beans there.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
如果狸猫没杀了我们，警察就会把我们关进监狱。不过没关系，我喜欢那里的豆子。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
If this goes well, we can get out of this cesspit and I can work at the mine again. So can you.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
如果计划顺利，我们就能摆脱这个泥潭，我也可以重新在矿场工作。你也是。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Anyway, kiddo, are you sure you can help us? There are monsters inside the mine that looks like cotton balls. Hunt them, and they'll leave behind deadly poisonous powder and explosive powder.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
总之，小家伙，你确定能帮上忙吗？矿场里有一些看起来像棉花球的魔物。去猎杀它们，它们会掉落剧毒粉和炸弹粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
I need 10 Deadly Poison Powders and.. let me see.. 1 Explosive Powder.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我需要10个剧毒粉和...让我看看...1个炸弹粉末。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Deadly poisonous powder? Are you going to kill them? You said you just want to scare them away.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
剧毒粉？你是要杀了他们吗？你刚才说只是想吓跑他们。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
It's deadly only to humans and Dorams. To those Tauruses, it only causes allergic reactions, like itching and sneezing.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
它只对人类和多兰致命。对那些野牛来说，只会引起过敏反应，比如瘙痒和打喷嚏。

scripts.text:
[Midnight]
I can go.
scripts.translation:
[午夜]
我可以去。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
No. You're going to get caught and ruin our plan before it even begins.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
不行。你会被抓，在计划开始前就搞砸一切。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Ah kiddo, speaking of which, could you cull some Gasters? That'll help us set up bombs later.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
啊，小家伙，说到这个，你能去清理一些瓦斯魔吗？这有助于我们稍后布置炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
The buffaloes would get out of the mine when the fireworks starts, but those clumps of gas could trigger chain reaction and blow up the entire mine. Hunt 15 of them for now. Can you do it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
当烟火开始时，野牛会逃出矿场，但那些气体团可能会引发连锁反应，炸毁整个矿场。先去猎杀15只。你能做到吗？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Sure.

[Demon]
I asked yes or no. Oh well, I'll take that as a yes.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我问的是“是”或“否”。算了，我就当你答应了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Now, here's the lowdown: get ^0000cd10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder^000000, and ^0000cdhunt 15 Gasters^000000. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
那么，情况是这样的：去收集^0000cd10份剧毒粉和1份炸弹粉末^000000，并且^0000cd猎杀15只瓦斯魔^000000。明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Demon]
We'll be counting on you, kiddo! I'll repay you generously when you come back. I was able to nab a few things while in jail at the sheriff's office. Now, off you go!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
我们就指望你了，小家伙！等你回来，我会好好报答你的。我在警长办公室坐牢的时候顺手拿了几样东西。现在，去吧！

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, kiddo, you forgot to hunt all the Gasters. We can't have Gasters around while we work.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
让我看看...嗯，小家伙，你还没把瓦斯魔都清理干净。我们工作的时候，周围不能有瓦斯魔。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hunt just 15 Gasters. There's no rush. You can take your time. Just come back before the end of the day today. I want to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
只需要猎杀15只瓦斯魔。不用急，慢慢来。只要在今天结束前回来就行。我想再见到你。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 10 Deadly Poison Powders. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
让我看看...嗯，你没带10份剧毒粉。那是制造炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 10 Deadly Poison Powders and 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，你能做到的，对吧？去从瓦斯魔那里弄10份剧毒粉和1份炸弹粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Mm, you didn't bring 1 Explosive Powder. That's the least amount I need to make a bomb.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
让我看看...嗯，你没带1份炸弹粉末。那是制造炸弹所需的最低数量。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Kiddo, you can do this, right? Get 1 Explosive Powder from Gasters.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
小家伙，你能做到的，对吧？去从瓦斯魔那里弄1份炸弹粉末。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Let's see... Ooh, kiddo, you got everything done! You hunted Gasters and brought what I asked.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
让我看看...哦，小家伙，你全都办好了！你猎杀了瓦斯魔，还带了我需要的东西。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
This is enough to keep me awake all night.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
这些足够让我整晚睡不着了。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Hey kiddo, do you mind helping me again tomorrow? I need more than one bomb to throw a firework party.
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
嘿，小家伙，你介意明天再帮我一次吗？我要举办烟火派对，需要不止一颗炸弹。

scripts.text:
[Demon]
Go rest today and come back tomorrow in the morning. See ya!
scripts.translation:
[恶魔]
今天去休息吧，明天早上再来。回见！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Aww, just one look at them,
and all I want to do is sneeze...
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
唉，只要看一眼它们，
我就只想打喷嚏...

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
What are you looking at? Were you eavesdropping on me?
Get your butt outta here! Git!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
你在看什么？是在偷听我说话吗？
赶紧滚出去！混蛋！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, you want to help me again.
Thanks, but I only have to patrol once a day. Why don't you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
哦，你想再帮我一次。
谢谢，但我每天只需要巡逻一次。你明天凌晨4点后再来吧？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Ah, stranger! You came to help again, right?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
啊，陌生人！你是来再次帮忙的，对吧？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Why not? Are you too busy today?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
为什么不来？是你今天太忙了吗？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Don't worry about your payment; I've got it covered. Just go get the job done.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
别担心报酬，我包了。你只管把活干完就行。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
*Groan* What do I do?
Maybe I should take a giant fan with me.
No. No, then everyone will find out.
Who's there?!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
*呻吟* 我该怎么办？
也许我该带把大扇子。
不，不行，那样大家都会发现的。
谁在那里？！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Mm? I'm pretty sure I haven't seen you around.
You're not one of the vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
嗯？我肯定没见过你。
你不是义警之一。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Wait, you're the stranger
who's been interfering with us!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
等等，你就是那个一直在妨碍我们的陌生人！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
...Oh, that's right! Hey stranger,
have you seen the monsters
called Gasters inside the mine?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
...啊，我想起来了！嘿，陌生人，你见过矿洞里那种叫瓦斯魔的魔物吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Gasters?
scripts.translation: 瓦斯魔？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Yes, those clumps of gas. They make me sneeze something fierce,
and turn into a weeping, drooling, sniffling mess. *Shudder*
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
对，就是那些气体团。它们让我喷嚏打个不停，
搞得我哭天抹泪、鼻涕横流。*战栗*

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Now, I've been assigned to go on patrol inside the mine, and I can't do it because of them.
But we Taurases take pride in our physical superiority. How can I tell the others that I can't do my job because I'm allergic to some gas?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
我被派去矿洞巡逻，却因为它们无法执行任务。
但我们托拉萨族以体格强壮为荣。我怎么能告诉别人，我因为对某种气体过敏而做不了工作呢？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
So I'm thinking
maybe you could help me.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
所以我在想，
也许你可以帮帮我。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Hunt ^FF000020 Gasters^000000 before I get in there.
I'll repay you. Please?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
在我进去之前，猎杀^FF000020只瓦斯魔^000000。
我会报答你的。拜托了？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Come on, I said I'd repay you.
Bah! Alright, then I won't force you.
But you'd better not tell anyone about this. Got it?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
拜托了，我说过会报答你的。
哼！好吧，那我就不勉强你了。
但你最好别告诉任何人这件事。听到了吗？

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Really? Thanks! I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
真的吗？谢谢！我就指望你了！

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Oh, and make sure no one knows about this.
That'll be bad for both of us.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
哦，还有，千万别让任何人知道这件事。
这对我们俩都不好。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
How many Gasters did you hunt?
I'm ready to go on patrol. Let me know when you're done.
I'll be counting on you, stranger.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
你猎杀了多少只瓦斯魔？
我准备好去巡逻了。完成后告诉我。
我就指望你了，陌生人。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you hunt all of them? By the way, why are you carrying so much stuff?
Go ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
你都猎杀完了吗？顺便问一句，你为什么携带这么多东西？
先^FF0000减轻你的负重^000000吧。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
Did you catch them all? I'd better finish my rounds before more of them spring up.
Thanks! Here, take this.
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
你都抓完了吗？我最好赶紧完成巡逻，免得它们又冒出来。
谢谢！拿着，这个给你。

scripts.text:
[Frail Ghast]
If you're not busy, come by tomorrow and help me again. I'll repay you.
This works for both of us, don't you agree?
scripts.translation:
[虚弱的食尸鬼]
如果你不忙，明天再来帮我一次吧。我会报答你的。
这对我们俩都有好处，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Hello. Are you new to this place? You should be ^FF0000at least Level 100^000000 to stay here comfortably?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你好。你是新来的吗？想在这里舒适地生活，至少得是^FF0000100级^000000吧？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Wait, what is my husband feeding that dog? Honey! That was our dinner!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
等等，我丈夫在给那只狗喂什么？蜂蜜！那是我们的晚餐！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
S-sweetheart, you shouldn't be outside when it's so windy. Let's go in.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
亲爱的，风这么大，你不该在外面。我们进去吧。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Grr, I can't believe you! You're getting only half your dinner tonight!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
哼，我真不敢相信你！今晚你只能吃一半的晚餐！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
He's an angel when he's in sleep, but... sigh... I already have a headache, just thinking about what he might do when he wakes up ^FF0000after 4:00 a.m.^000000
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
他睡着的时候像个天使，但是...唉...光是想想他^FF0000凌晨4点^000000醒来后可能会做的事，我就已经头疼了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, thank you for coming back. We've checked all the holes Spotty dug inside the village, but we couldn't find what we were looking for. He must have taken it to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
冒险者，谢谢你回来。我们检查了斑点在村子里挖的所有洞，但没找到我们要找的东西。它一定是带去荒野了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
