As I told you before, we've got something for you this time: ^0000CD1 Rock Ridge Coin^000000. Say, could you help us?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
就像我之前告诉你的，这次我们有东西给你：^0000CD1洛克里奇硬币^000000。请问，你能帮帮我们吗？

scripts.text: Help.
scripts.translation: 帮忙

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
We have no one else to turn to. Please come back if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我们没人可以求助了。如果你改变主意，请回来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Today Spotty took a {0}. Could you look for it? It may be easily replaceable, but I can't keep buying things every time Spotty takes something.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
今天斑点叼走了一件{0}。你能帮我找找吗？虽然这东西可能很容易买到，但我不能每次斑点叼走东西都去买新的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Go outside the village and talk to my husband. He'll tell you where it might be.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
去村外找我丈夫。他会告诉你东西可能在哪里。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty would be a perfect dog if he doesn't take things out of the house. Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
如果斑点不总是叼走家里的东西，它本来可以成为一只完美的狗。唉...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Adventurer, we've found the ring!
After all the time we spent searching the village, we've found it inside his house.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
冒险者，我们找到戒指了！
在村子里找了那么久，最后竟然是在它家里找到的。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
By the way, what's that shining thing in your hand?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
顺便问一下，你手里那个闪闪发光的东西是什么？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Oh, you want to ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first before showing it to me. Sure!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
哦，你想先^FF0000减轻负重^000000再给我看吗？当然可以！

scripts.text: Show what's in your hand.
scripts.translation: 展示手中的物品

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
This is a Rock Ridge Coin. You can use it like money inside the village. I wasn't comfortable letting you help us for free. I'm glad you can at least have this.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这是一枚洛克里奇硬币。你可以在村子里把它当钱用。我不忍心让你免费帮我们。很高兴你至少能收下这个。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
That Rock Ridge Coin is yours. Thank you for helping us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这枚洛克里奇硬币归你了。谢谢你帮我们的忙。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
And, mm... Do you mind helping us again tomorrow? Spotty keeps taking things from the house to the wasteland, and we need them back.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
还有，那个...你介意明天再帮帮我们吗？斑点总是把家里的东西叼到荒野去，我们需要把它们找回来。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty tired itself out and fell asleep. Could you come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.? We'll have something to give you next time.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
斑点累得睡着了。你能在明天凌晨4点后再回来吗？下次我们会给你准备一些东西。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Did you find what we asked? I can't see it because you're carrying too much stuff with you. Could you ^FF0000lighten your bag^000000 first?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你找到我们要的东西了吗？因为你携带的东西太多，我看不到。你能先^FF0000减轻负重^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
You've found it! Thank you so much. We've been trying to correct Spotty's behavior, and it's difficult.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你找到了！非常感谢。我们一直在试图纠正斑点的行为，但这很难。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Here's the Rock Ridge Coin we promised. Thank you for searching the wasteland for us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
这是我们要给你的洛克里奇硬币。谢谢你帮我们在荒野里寻找。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Could you come back again? If you're not busy, you're welcome anytime after 4:00 a.m each day.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你能再回来一次吗？如果你不忙，每天凌晨4点后随时欢迎。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
How many times do I have to tell you to keep your dog away from our things? Do you really want me to send it away on a ship?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我要告诉你多少次，让你把狗从我们的东西旁边赶走？你真的想让我把它送上船送走吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Why? What did he do this time?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
为什么？它这次又做了什么？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I can't live like this anymore! Guess what Spotty stole this time? My ring!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我受够了这种日子了！猜猜斑点这次偷了什么？我的戒指！

scripts.text: Check what's going on.
scripts.translation: 查看情况

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
HONEY! Are you even listening to me?!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
亲爱的！你到底有没有在听我说话？！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
My mom gave me that ring before I left for this foreign land. I was keeping it for a rainy day, and that mongrel stole it from me!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
那是妈妈在我离开家乡去这片异国他乡之前送给我的。我留着以备不时之需，结果那只杂种狗把它偷走了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
You mean the gold ring you love? Uh-oh, Spotty is in big trouble.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
你是说那个你心爱的金戒指？哎呀，斑点这次大祸临头了。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I tried to be understanding when it took our shoes and laundry and buried them in the ground, but no, not my ring!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
它把我们的长靴和衣服拿去埋进土里的时候，我还试着理解它，但是不行，我的戒指绝对不行！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Sweetheart, please calm down. Is it possible you left it where he could reach it?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
亲爱的，请冷静一下。有没有可能你把它放在它能拿到的地方了？

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Are you kidding me? I never take it off except when I do the dishes or laundry,
and even then I keep it in my pocket. I dropped it just this once, and that mongrel got ahold of it!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你在开玩笑吗？除了洗碗或洗衣服的时候，我从不摘下它，
而且即便如此，我也会把它放在口袋里。我只有一次不小心掉了，结果就被那只杂种狗捡走了！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
It's been two months since you quit your job, and instead of helping around the house, you've been spoiling that dog. You're responsible for its misbehavior!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你辞职已经两个月了，不但没帮忙做家务，还一直宠着那只狗。它的坏毛病都是你造成的！

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I saw it run to the wasteland. Go find my ring. You'd better not come back home without it!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我看见它跑向荒野了。去把我的戒指找回来。要是没找到就别回家！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
What? I'm a miner, not a fighter? I can't go out there! You know I couldn't stay out there long enough to find my hat when it flew away in that direction.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
什么？我是矿工，不是格斗家？我没法去那里！你知道的，我的帽子被风吹到那个方向时，我连在那儿待够时间找回来都做不到。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
I don't know, and I don't care!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我不知道，我也不在乎！

scripts.text: Join the conversation.
scripts.translation: 加入对话

scripts.text: Pass.
scripts.translation: 放弃

scripts.text: - That's none of my business. I'm just going to pass. -
scripts.translation: - 这不关我的事。我只是路过。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Wah! Geez, who are you?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
哇！天哪，你是谁？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, you're the adventurer who just arrived in these parts. Hah hah, don't be so surprised. I know because
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
啊，你就是刚来到这一带的冒险者吧。哈哈，别惊讶。我知道，因为

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
you sit by the dock all day, playing with the dog. Of course, I know everyone who comes and goes.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你整天坐在码头边，跟那只狗玩。当然，我知道每一个来来去去的人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
*Clenches his teeth* Sweetheart, let's not start it right now.
Anyway, what can we do for you?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
*咬牙切齿* 亲爱的，现在别开始吵了。
总之，我们能为你做些什么？

scripts.text: Say you want to help them find the ring.
scripts.translation: 表示想帮他们找戒指

scripts.text: Say hello.
scripts.translation: 打个招呼

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Why, hello to you, too.
You're silly.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
你好啊。
你真傻。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Huh? You want to help us. Thank you, but no, thanks. We can't pay you.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
什么？你想帮我们？谢谢，但不用了。我们付不起报酬。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
And I know for a fact that no one offers help for free anymore.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我确信，现在没有人会免费帮忙了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Wait, honey. You should think again. You and I are too afraid of the Buffalo Bandits to go out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
等等，亲爱的。你再想想。我和你都太害怕野牛强盗了，不敢去荒野。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
We have no one else to turn to, and I can't think of a better way than this. Let's take a chance on this adventurer.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我们也没别人可以求助了，我想不出比这更好的办法。就赌一把，相信这位冒险者吧。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
You're right, but... Sigh...
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
你说得对，但是... 唉...

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Mm, Adventurer, let me take back what I just said. Please help us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
嗯，冒险者，让我收回刚才的话。请帮帮我们。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Spotty digs holes and buries things in them every day. If you find holes in the wasteland, please look inside them.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
Spotty每天都会在荒野挖洞并把东西埋进去。如果你在荒野发现洞，请看看里面。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
My husband and I will look around the village, just in case. If you find something, please come back here.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
我和我丈夫会在村庄周围找找，以防万一。如果你找到了什么，请回到这里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I picked up Spotty in the wasteland. Maybe that's why he loves spending time there so much. But he never ventures so far out that he can't make it home before it's mealtime. At least, not yet.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我是在荒野捡到Spotty的。也许这就是他那么喜欢在那里的原因。但他从来不会走太远，至少现在不会，他总能在饭点前赶回家。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Go out to the wasteland, and you'll see the marks that I've left on your map. You don't have to search any places beyond them.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
去荒野看看，你会看到我在地图上留下的标记。你不需要搜索标记以外的地方。

scripts.text:
[Mrs. McPhy]
Honey, you should at least follow the adventurer to the gates, so you could tell him where to look.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲夫人]
亲爱的，你至少应该送冒险者到门口，告诉他该往哪里找。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
S-should I? Uh, mm... Okay.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我...我应该吗？呃，嗯... 好吧。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife said Spotty went out the back door and ran straight past the barbed-wire fence.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我妻子说Spotty从后门出去，直接穿过了铁丝网围栏。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
But he couldn't have gone too far because he came back to me pretty quickly. Why don't you walk along the fence and look for holes with white hair floating around them?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
但他不可能走太远，因为他很快就回来了。你沿着围栏走走，找找周围飘着白毛的洞吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Did you find something? Then let's go back!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
你找到什么了吗？那我们回去吧！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife sent me here to give you directions, but I have no idea where he might have been.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我妻子让我来给你指路，但我完全不知道他可能去了哪里。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Oh, right! Spotty has been shedding a lot lately. Maybe you should look for holes with white hair floating around them.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
哦，对了！Spotty最近掉毛很厉害。也许你应该找找周围飘着白毛的洞。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
And he doesn't seem to venture out too far. It's probably because he's still young. I've marked three possible locations in the middle of your map. You don't have to look further than those locations.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
而且他似乎不会走太远。可能是因为他还小。我在地图中间标记了三个可能的位置。你不需要找得比那些位置更远。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, Adventurer. Shhh! Please keep your voice down: the Buffalo Bandits might hear us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
啊，冒险者。嘘！请小声点：野牛强盗可能会听到我们。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I've been coming here whenever I can, to catch Spotty before he takes more things out to the wasteland.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我一有机会就来这里，想在Spotty带更多东西去荒野之前抓住他。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife says she'd throw him out, but she doesn't mean it. She never raises her hand no matter how angry she is with him either, and she always remembers to feed him vitamins and get him vaccinated.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我妻子说要把他赶出去，但她不是真心的。无论多生气，她从不打他，而且总是记得给他喂维生素和打疫苗。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
She didn't say anything when I quit my job because I was too scared of the Buffalo Bandits. She's a good woman.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我因为太害怕野牛强盗而辞职时，她什么也没说。她是个好女人。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
*Gasp* Buffalo Bandits!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
*倒吸一口凉气* 野牛强盗！

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面散落着一些白色的毛发。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has wet soil inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面只有湿漉漉的土壤。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It's empty. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面是空的。 -

scripts.text: - I don't have to search farther than this. -
scripts.translation: - 我不需要再往更远的地方找了。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a little bit of white hair scattered inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面散落着一些白色的毛发。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has something shining inside it,
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面有东西在闪闪发光，

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has something inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面有些东西。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has a stone sticking out of the ground inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面只有一块从地里露出来的石头。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a small animal bone inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面有一根小动物的骨头。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It has a tumbleweed rolling around inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面有一团滚动的杂草。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
A small insect is scuttling around inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面有一只小虫子在爬来爬去。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It only has weeds growing inside it. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面只长着一些杂草。 -

scripts.text:
- There's a hole in the ground.
It's only filled with dust. -
scripts.translation:
- 地上有个洞。
里面只填满了灰尘。 -

scripts.text: - There's a hole in the ground.
scripts.translation: - 地上有个洞。

scripts.text:
But it's not a gold ring.
I should take it with me for now. -
scripts.translation:
但它不是金戒指。
我先把它带走吧。 -

scripts.text: - This must be what Mr. McPhy is looking for. I should bring it to her. -
scripts.translation: - 这一定是麦克菲先生在找的东西。我应该把它带给他。 -

scripts.text: - He looks more like a coyote than a dog. -
scripts.translation: - 他看起来更像是一只寇犹铁，而不是一只狗。 -

scripts.text: - He's asleep, covered in dirt as if he rolled around in it. I shouldn't wake him up. -
scripts.translation: - 他睡着了，浑身沾满泥土，像是滚过泥地一样。我不应该叫醒他。 -

scripts.text: - He looks more like a coyote than a dog. -
scripts.translation: - 他看起来更像是一只寇犹铁，而不是一只狗。 -

scripts.text: - He's shedding a lot of hair. He must be leaving white hair all over the place wherever he goes. -
scripts.translation: - 他掉毛很厉害。他走到哪里都会留下白色的毛发。 -

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Spotty, do you want a treat? Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
Spotty，想吃点零食吗？嗯？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
My wife and I decided to check the village separately, but I'm not sure if we'd be done before you're back.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我和妻子决定分开去检查村庄，但我不确定在你回来之前我们能否完成。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Adventurer, thank you for checking that dangerous area for my wife's gold ring.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
冒险者，谢谢你替我妻子去那个危险的地方寻找金戒指。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I believe the universe has brought you to us as an act of Providence. Do you mind if I ask you one more favor?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我相信是命运让你来到了我们身边。你介意我再请你帮一个忙吗？

scripts.text: Listen to what he has to say.
scripts.translation: 听听他有什么要说的。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I can really repay you this time. Please let me know if you change your mind.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
这次我真的可以报答你了。如果你改变主意，请告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
We keep a rifle in the house for self-defense purposes, and the other day I noticed Spotty trembled like a leaf when he saw it.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
家里有一把步枪用于自卫，前几天我发现Spotty看到它时吓得像树叶一样颤抖。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I'm glad I was too scared to have it loaded. Spotty wouldn't have come back home if he smelled gunpowder.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
幸好我当时太害怕，没有往里面装子弹。如果Spotty闻到火药味，它就不会回家了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I think someone fired a gun near Spotty, but it didn't happen inside the village. We would've heard if it did.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我觉得有人在Spotty附近开了枪，但这不是在村庄里发生的。如果是的话，我们肯定听到了。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I think it happened in the wasteland and that one of the Buffalo Bandits fired at our dog. Could you avenge Spotty on my behalf?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我觉得那是在荒野发生的，可能是某个野牛强盗朝我们的狗开了枪。你能替我为Spotty报仇吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Since you brought back my wife's gold ring, I've been taking odd jobs to supplement our income. We can afford to repay you now.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
既然你找回了我妻子的金戒指，我就一直在做零工来补贴家用。现在我们有能力报答你了。

scripts.text: Help him.
scripts.translation: 帮助他。

scripts.text: Decline.
scripts.translation: 拒绝

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
You're not afraid of the bandits, are you?
Okay, I understand if you can't help us.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
你不怕那些强盗，对吧？
好吧，如果你帮不了我们，我理解。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Since there's no way of knowing exactly who scared Spotty, I'd like you to hunt 3 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
既然无法确切知道是谁吓到了Spotty，我希望你能猎杀每种3只狸猫：黄毛、黑毛和白毛。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
I'll be waiting.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我会等着的。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Spotty, are you alright? Don't be scared. Daddy's with you.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
Spotty，你没事吧？别害怕。爸爸在你身边。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Those evil bandits, how could they shoot their guns near puppies?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
那些邪恶的强盗，他们怎么能对着小狗开枪呢？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, Adventurer. Did you hunt ^FF00003 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane^000000?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
啊，冒险者。你猎杀了^FF0000每种3只狸猫：黄毛、黑毛和白毛^000000吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Ah, you must have forgotten about your payment. Please go ^FF0000make some room in your bag^000000 for it.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
啊，你肯定忘了你的报酬了。请^FF0000在包里腾出一些空间^000000来装它。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Did you take care of all the darned Buffalo Bandits?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
你处理完那些讨厌的野牛强盗了吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
But there are so many of them that this wouldn't even leave a dent on them. I want to take it further.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
但是它们数量太多了，这甚至不会让它们减少多少。我想更进一步。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
We should do this just once a day. They would know something is amiss if we get rid of too many of them at once. Please come back tomorrow after 4:00 a.m.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
我们最好每天只这样做一次。如果一次消灭太多，它们就会察觉出不对劲。请在明天凌晨4:00之后再来。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Oh, right?here's your payment I promised. Thank you.
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
哦，对了？这是答应给你的报酬。谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Honey! Did Spotty take my watch?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
亲爱的！斑点是不是拿走了我的手表？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Let me see what time it is... It's not past ^FF00004:00 a.m.^000000 yet. Could you come back later?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
让我看看现在几点了...还没到^FF0000凌晨4:00^000000呢。你能稍后再来吗？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Adventurer, I've been waiting for you! You came to avenge Spotty on the Buffalo Bandits, right?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
冒险者，我一直在等你！你是来为斑点向野牛强盗复仇的吧？

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
As usual, please hunt ^FF00003 bandits of each kind: yellow, black, and white mane^000000.
I'll be counting on you!
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
和往常一样，请猎杀^FF0000每种3只狸猫：黄毛、黑毛和白毛^000000。
拜托你了！

scripts.text:
[Mr. McPhy]
Oh, poor Spotty. You're itching from losing so much hair. Do you want your daddy to brush you?
scripts.translation:
[麦克菲先生]
哦，可怜的斑点。掉了那么多毛，你一定很痒吧。想让爸爸给你梳毛吗？

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
Coyotes have been attacking our villages often lately, so we've asked some adventurers to cull them.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
最近寇犹铁经常袭击我们的村庄，所以我们请了一些冒险者来清除它们。

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
It worries me that our children thinks hunting is just for fun.
We start to teach our young how to hunt early on,
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
我很担心孩子们觉得打猎只是好玩。
我们从小就开始教孩子们打猎，

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
and I understand they want to become as strong as those adventurers.
But we Cacti don't hunt for pleasure. Teaching that to our children is challenging while adventurers are around them constantly.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
我理解他们想变得像那些冒险者一样强壮。
但我们仙人掌族打猎不是为了取乐。在冒险者总是身边的情况下，教导孩子们这一点很有挑战性。

scripts.text:
[Tagliatelle]
I love traveling. I had fun traveling in Pa-sta, and I'm determined to spend the rest of my life traveling in Rune-Midgarts and other cities and villages that I can reach from the kingdom.
scripts.translation:
[塔亚泰莱]
我喜欢旅行。我在帕斯塔旅行得很开心，我决心在卢恩·米德加兹以及我能从王国到达的其他城市和村庄度过余生。

scripts.text:
[Tagliatelle]
I like being in new places and talking to the residents. I can learn many things from the way they live.
scripts.translation:
[塔亚泰莱]
我喜欢身处新的地方，和居民交谈。我可以从他们的生活方式中学到很多东西。

scripts.text:
[Taneska]
I love these new musical instruments!
scripts.translation:
[塔涅斯卡]
我喜欢这些新的乐器！

scripts.text:
[Taneska]
This instrument itself is a work of art.
Check out the exquisite finish around the drum skin, and the well-balanced, full-bodied sound from the barrel.
scripts.translation:
[塔涅斯卡]
这件乐器本身就是一件艺术品。
看看鼓皮周围精致的工艺，以及从鼓身发出的平衡、饱满的声音。

scripts.text:
[Taneska]
Ah, I want to beat this drum! I'd love to hear its sound!
scripts.translation:
[塔涅斯卡]
啊，我想敲敲这个鼓！我想听听它的声音！

scripts.text:
[Tagliatelle]
*Gasp* Taneska, please don't touch it! You were warned once already!
scripts.translation:
[塔亚泰莱]
*倒吸一口凉气* 塔涅斯卡，请不要碰它！我已经警告过你一次了！

scripts.text:
[Glaring Eagle]
The strangers lost the battle with the sea and relinquished their homes. I thought they'd leave, but they're as resilient as weeds; they built another village on top of their old homes.
scripts.translation:
[怒目之鹰]
那些陌生人与大海的战斗失败了，放弃了他们的家园。我以为他们会离开，但他们像杂草一样顽强；他们在旧家园之上又建了一个村庄。

scripts.text:
[Litis]
Mother Nature allows weeds to grow. She's allowing them to stay here.
scripts.translation:
[利蒂斯]
大自然允许杂草生长。她允许它们留在这里。

scripts.text:
[Glaring Eagle]
I know, Litis. I'm just being a stubborn old mule.
But still I can't help but think that everything's happening too fast.
scripts.translation:
[怒目之鹰]
我知道，利蒂斯。我只是像头倔强的老骡子。
但我还是忍不住觉得一切都发生得太快了。

scripts.text:
[Karintas]
My mom is better at hunting coyotes than any adventurer. I can hunt them, too!
scripts.translation:
[卡林塔斯]
我妈妈打猎寇犹铁比任何冒险者都厉害。我也能猎杀它们！

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
Karintas, has your mom ever hunted them for pleasure?
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
卡林塔斯，你妈妈有没有为了好玩而猎杀过它们？

scripts.text:
[Karintas]
Mm, no. She hunts them only when we need their fur and meat.
scripts.translation:
[卡林塔斯]
嗯，没有。只有当我们急需它们的皮毛和肉时，她才会去猎杀。

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
Hurting nature should never be a game. These adventurers only hunt enough coyotes to keep us safe from them.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
伤害自然绝不应该是一场游戏。这些冒险者猎杀寇犹铁，只是为了保护我们的安全。

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
If you get old enough to understand that, your mother will teach you how to hunt.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
等你长大到能明白这个道理时，你妈妈会教你如何狩猎。

scripts.text:
[Juanitas]
I'm the best coyote-hunting adventurer! I'm going to hunt a hundred coyotes!
scripts.translation:
[胡安妮塔斯]
我是最厉害的猎寇犹铁冒险者！我要去猎杀一百只寇犹铁！

scripts.text:
[Agile Scorpion]
I-I'm Captain Adventurer! I'm going to hunt a hundred-hundred-hundred-hundred coyotes!
scripts.translation:
[敏捷之蝎]
我...我是船长冒险者！我要去猎杀一百...一百...一百...一百只寇犹铁！

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
You rascals, I told you not to play adventurers?they're not playing!
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
你们这些捣蛋鬼，我告诉过你们不要玩冒险者游戏吗？他们不是在玩！

scripts.text:
[Agile Scorpion]
*Whine* But we want to hunt coyotes like them. Yap! Yap, yap! Hoi!
scripts.translation:
[敏捷之蝎]
*呜咽* 但我们想像他们一样猎杀寇犹铁。汪！汪汪！嗨！

scripts.text:
[Karintas]
Maybe the grownups in our village should go out and hunt coyotes, too.
scripts.translation:
[卡林塔斯]
也许我们村子里的大人们也应该出去猎杀寇犹铁。

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
You knuckleheads, we don't want to hunt them.
We want to live with them peacefully in this Kiwawa Desert.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
你们这些笨蛋，我们不想猎杀它们。
我们想和它们在这契瓦瓦沙漠里和平共处。

scripts.text:
[Curt Snake]
It's just not safe for us to have too many coyotes around. That's why we asked the adventurers for help.
But that doesn't mean we want to get rid of all of them.
scripts.translation:
[冷淡的蛇]
只是周围有太多的寇犹铁对我们来说并不安全。所以我们才请求冒险者帮忙。
但这并不意味着我们要消灭它们所有。

scripts.text:
[Litis]
I understand what Mr. Glaring Eagle means and why he's so worried.
scripts.translation:
[利蒂斯]
我理解怒目之鹰先生的意思，也明白他为何如此担忧。

scripts.text:
[Litis]
But the river today is not the same river it was yesterday. Things keep changing, and it's natural.
scripts.translation:
[利蒂斯]
但今天的河流已不再是昨天的河流。万物都在变化，这是自然的规律。

scripts.text:
[Roytanen]
*Gasp* I'm back in the Cactus village. Aww, I'm lost? again.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊塔宁]
*倒吸一口凉气* 我又回到仙人掌村了。哎呀，我又迷路了。

scripts.text:
[Roytanen]
The Kiwawa Desert is vast and full of nothing but dirt and rocks. It's easy to get lost in it.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊塔宁]
契瓦瓦沙漠广阔无垠，除了泥土和岩石什么都没有。在这里很容易迷路。

scripts.text:
[Roytanen]
Gosh, I'm really not up to yet another excursion... I hope I could get a glass of cool water before I leave.
scripts.translation:
[罗伊塔宁]
天哪，我真的不想再经历一次这样的旅程了...希望在我离开前能喝上一杯凉水。

scripts.text:
[Central Road Sign]
Follow this road east to get to the inn, the sheriff's office, shops, and the plaza.
scripts.translation:
[中央路标]
沿这条路向东走，可前往旅馆、警长办公室、商店和广场。

scripts.text:
[Central Road Sign]
This road also goes outside the village, to the Kiwawa Desert.
scripts.translation:
[中央路标]
这条路也通往村外，前往契瓦瓦沙漠。

scripts.text:
[Plaza Sign]
The Kafra services are available inside the Rock Ridge Plaza.
scripts.translation:
[广场标牌]
卡普拉服务在洛克理奇广场内提供。

scripts.text:
[Plaza Sign]
The sheriff's office and shop buildings are west of this plaza. The inn and the port are farther west.
scripts.translation:
[广场标牌]
警长办公室和商店位于广场西侧。旅馆和港口在更西边。

scripts.text:
[Karam Pucci]
Do you want to go back to Alberta?
scripts.translation:
[卡拉姆·普奇]
你想回到艾尔贝塔吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Karam Pucci]
No problem. I don't mind staying here for a little longer.
In fact, my company would like that too.
scripts.translation:
[卡拉姆·普奇]
没问题。我不介意在这里多待一会儿。
事实上，我的公司也这么希望。

scripts.text:
[Karam Pucci]
Then let's go!
scripts.translation:
[卡拉姆·普奇]
那我们出发吧！

scripts.text:
[Rubina Adler]
Mm, mm! Agave juice is the best thing I've tasted in Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation:
[鲁宾娜·阿德勒]
嗯，嗯！龙舌兰汁是我在洛克理奇喝过最好喝的东西。

scripts.text:
[Rubina Adler]
I've heard it's a traditional drink of the Cacti. When I drink it, it feels as if it washes away all the dust clogging up my throat.
scripts.translation:
[鲁宾娜·阿德勒]
我听说这是仙人掌人的传统饮品。喝下去的时候，感觉喉咙里堵塞的灰尘都被冲走了。

scripts.text:
[Rubina Adler]
Err, wait. It's not real agave juice. It says agave-flavored juice.
scripts.translation:
[鲁宾娜·阿德勒]
呃，等等。这不是真正的龙舌兰汁。上面写的是龙舌兰风味果汁。

scripts.text:
[Rubina Adler]
Ack, does it even have agave in it?
scripts.translation:
[鲁宾娜·阿德勒]
天哪，里面真的有龙舌兰吗？

scripts.text:
[Zebedee]
Welcome to Rock Ridge!
I hope you'll find your opportunity in this land of dreams.
scripts.translation:
[西庇太]
欢迎来到洛克理奇！
希望你在梦想之地能找到属于你的机遇。

scripts.text:
[Irene]
Welcome to Rock Ridge, adventurer!
I hope you'll enjoy exploring this wonderful place.
scripts.translation:
[艾琳]
欢迎来到洛克理奇，冒险者！
希望您能享受探索这片美好土地的乐趣。

scripts.text:
[Miles Wiesner]
I'm waiting for my sister. She's supposed to be on the next ship.
I came here first and invited her over here.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔斯·维斯纳]
我在等我的妹妹。她应该坐下一班船过来。
我先来到这里，然后邀请她过来。

scripts.text:
[Miles Wiesner]
She was worried sick when I decided to leave for this continent a year ago.
She'll be happy to see me doing well.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔斯·维斯纳]
一年前我决定离开去这片大陆时，她担心坏了。
看到我过得很好，她一定会很高兴的。

scripts.text:
[Miles Wiesner]
The land of opportunity, that's Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation:
[迈尔斯·维斯纳]
机遇之地，那就是洛克理奇。

scripts.text:
[Cheerful Leaf]
My gramps is the best Cactus I know!
Sometimes he says things that I can't understand, but it's okay.
scripts.translation:
[快活的叶子]
我的老爷爷是我认识的最棒的仙人掌！
有时候他说的话我听不懂，但没关系。

scripts.text:
[Cheerful Leaf]
I hope I can understand him better when I grow as tall as he.
I want to grow up quickly, so I could ask him to tell me the things he told me again.
scripts.translation:
[快活的叶子]
我希望等我长得和他一样高时，能更懂他。
我想快点长大，这样就能让他再给我讲一遍那些故事了。

scripts.text:
[Mahua Kaya]
Some Cacti don't like the pioneers, but, Leaf, remember they're also children of Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[玛华·卡雅]
有些仙人掌不喜欢拓荒者，但叶子，记住他们也是自然母亲的孩子们。

scripts.text:
[Cheerful Leaf]
Children? Are they as cute as Leaf?
scripts.translation:
[快活的叶子]
孩子们？他们和叶子一样可爱吗？

scripts.text:
[Mahua Kaya]
Of course. Everyone even this old man is a child in the eyes of Mother Nature.
scripts.translation:
[玛华·卡雅]
当然。即使是像我这样的老人，在自然母亲眼中也是孩子。

scripts.text:
[Cheerful Leaf]
Hah hah hah! That doesn't make sense. You're tall and have a mustache. Babies don't have mustaches.
scripts.translation:
[快活的叶子]
哈哈哈哈哈！这说不通。你又高又有胡子。宝宝没有胡子的。

scripts.text:
[Mahua Kaya]
I'm saying you should be nice to them like you are to your friends.
Do you understand me, Leaf?
scripts.translation:
[玛华·卡雅]
我的意思是，你要像对待朋友一样善待他们。
你懂我的意思吗，叶子？

scripts.text:
[Cheerful Leaf]
Yes. Leaf is a good Cactus and he loves his gramps.
scripts.translation:
[快活的叶子]
懂。叶子是乖仙人掌，而且他爱他的老爷爷。

scripts.text:
[Welch]
Have you just arrived? So have I, two days ago. The wind sounds different here. I love it!
scripts.translation:
[韦尔奇]
你刚到这里吗？我也是，两天前才来的。这里的风声听起来很特别。我很喜欢！

scripts.text:
[Welch]
All the buildings smell like fresh paint, and I hear the sound of hammering everywhere I go. This village is alive!
scripts.translation:
[韦尔奇]
所有的建筑都散发着新油漆的味道，走到哪里都能听到敲打声。这个村庄充满了生机！

scripts.text:
[Welch]
Just standing here makes me so happy that I can't stop laughing. Hah hah hah!
scripts.translation:
[韦尔奇]
光是站在这里，我就开心得停不下来。哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Edith Richie]
My dad works at the train station.
It's east? mm, wait. West is the left hand side, and...
scripts.translation:
[伊迪丝·里奇]
我爸爸在火车站工作。
是在东边吗？嗯，等等。西边是左手边，然后...

scripts.text:
[Edith Richie]
Just look at your map and go straight up. You'll be at the train station.
My father is so strong, he can carry many boxes at once!
scripts.translation:
[伊迪丝·里奇]
看看你的地图，一直往上走就能到火车站了。
我爸爸力气很大，一次能搬很多箱子！

scripts.text:
[Carmen O'Neil]
*Hiccups* I can drink beer all day long!
scripts.translation:
[卡门·奥尼尔]
*打嗝* 我可以整天喝啤酒！

scripts.text:
[Leland Wenkins]
Let's make money and - hee hee! - eat something delicious!
scripts.translation:
[利兰·温金斯]
我们要赚钱，然后——嘿嘿嘿！——吃点好吃的！

scripts.text:
[Drunk Doram]
I want more chicken, nya! And chicken is really easy on my stomach.
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的多兰]
我要吃更多的小鸡，喵！而且小鸡对胃很温和。

scripts.text:
[Leland Wenkins]
Cheers for our great village! Cheers!
scripts.translation:
[利兰·温金斯]
为我们伟大的村庄干杯！干杯！

scripts.text:
[Carmen O'Neil]
For the pioneering spirit! Cheers!
scripts.translation:
[卡门·奥尼尔]
为了开拓精神！干杯！

scripts.text:
[Drunk Doram]
*Hiccups* Cheers! Nya-nya!
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的多兰]
*打嗝* 干杯！喵~喵~

scripts.text:
[Maybell]
Rock Ridge is a seaside village. In the beginning?well, even now it's battling with the sea.
scripts.translation:
[梅贝尔]
洛克理奇是一个海滨村庄。起初？嗯，直到现在它都在与大海抗争。

scripts.text:
[Maybell]
Did you know there's one more level underneath this village? That was the original Rock Ridge, and it became uninhabitable because of seawater erosion and groundwater inundation.
scripts.translation:
[梅贝尔]
你知道这个村庄下面还有一层吗？那是最初的洛克理奇，因为海水侵蚀和地下水涌入而变得无法居住。

scripts.text:
[Maybell]
Mayor Costell's solution was to bury the first level and build a new village on top of it. And now what used to be the first floor is the basement. The second floor is actually the first.
scripts.translation:
[梅贝尔]
市长科斯特尔的解决方案是掩埋第一层，并在上面建造新的村庄。现在，原来的一楼变成了地下室。二楼实际上是一楼。

scripts.text:
[Maybell]
We still have to pump out water on a daily basis to prevent flooding, but that's just a minor setback?we took one step back to move two steps forward. Rock Ridge will continue to grow.
scripts.translation:
[梅贝尔]
我们仍然需要每天抽水以防止洪水，但这只是个小挫折？我们退一步是为了进两步。洛克理奇会继续发展。

scripts.text:
[Rosemary Weber]
I'm tired of being surrounded by so much water! It's the reason we constantly have to repair the ground and buildings standing on it.
Did you know we had to bury what used to be the ground level of the village? That was a difficult decision to make, and it still didn't solve all our problems.
scripts.translation:
[罗斯玛丽·韦伯]
我受够了被这么多水包围！这就是我们不得不不断修复地面和建筑物的原因。
你知道我们不得不掩埋原来的地面层吗？那是一个艰难的决定，而且它并没有解决所有问题。

scripts.text:
[Rosemary Weber]
Most of the buildings were made of wood and prone to rotting. It took a lot of money and effort to fill them thoroughly, so our new ground level wouldn't sink in.
scripts.translation:
[罗斯玛丽·韦伯]
大多数建筑是木制的，容易腐烂。为了填充它们，花费了大量的金钱和精力，这样新的地面层才不会下沉。

scripts.text:
[Rosemary Weber]
And the filling work still hasn't been finished. Sigh, I don't know if that was even a good decision anymore.
scripts.translation:
[罗斯玛丽·韦伯]
而且填充工作还没有完成。唉，我不知道那是否是一个好的决定了。

scripts.text:
[Leland Wenkins]
We are the great pioneers of Rock Ridge! Hey, ho!
scripts.translation:
[利兰·温金斯]
我们是洛克理奇伟大的开拓者！嘿，吼！

scripts.text:
[Carmen O'Neil]
We dig mines, build houses! No seawater or sandstorms can stop us!
scripts.translation:
[卡门·奥尼尔]
我们挖掘矿藏，建造房屋！海水和沙尘暴都阻挡不了我们！

scripts.text:
[Drunk Doram]
Nya! Nya-nya! Nya hah hah! Nya-nya!
scripts.translation:
[喝醉的多兰]
喵！喵喵！喵哈哈！喵喵！

scripts.text:
[Elsie]
Whoa, so pretty!
scripts.translation:
[埃尔西]
哇，好漂亮！

scripts.text:
[Elsie]
It's five million Zeny. How much money is that?
scripts.translation:
[埃尔西]
五百万Zeny。这得是多少钱啊？

scripts.text:
[Mortimer]
Ah, that price is for adventurers only.
Pretty little ladies like you can have it at two hundred Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[莫蒂默]
啊，那个价格只针对冒险者。
像您这样漂亮的小姐，只要两百Zeny就可以买到了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I'm pretty and little, too.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我也又漂亮又娇小。

scripts.text:
[Mortimer]
...You're either delusional
or shameless.
scripts.translation:
[莫蒂默]
...你要么是疯了，要么是无耻。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
You're shameless!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你才无耻！

scripts.text:
[Mortimer]
Souvenirs! I've got souvenirs!
Get souvenirs for your family, friends, teachers, and significant other!
scripts.translation:
[莫蒂默]
纪念品！我有纪念品！
给你的家人、朋友、老师和恋人买些纪念品吧！

scripts.text:
[Mortimer]
Ah, adventurer. Would you like to buy some souvenirs?
scripts.translation:
[莫蒂默]
啊，冒险者。你想买些纪念品吗？

scripts.text:
[Mortimer]
I'll give you a special discount. This feather accessory here is just two million Zeny. This handkerchief here is - oh, wow! - just five million!
scripts.translation:
[莫蒂默]
我会给你特别折扣。这个羽毛饰品只要两百万Zeny。这条手帕是——哇哦！——只要五百万！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
How exorbitant!

[Walter Greenwald]
I assume you came all the way here from the mainland for a reason.
When you're done with it and not sure what else to do, well...
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·格林瓦尔德]
我想你从大陆大老远来到这里，肯定是有原因的。
等你办完事，如果不知道接下来该做什么的话...

scripts.text:
[Walter Greenwald]
I recommend you follow the central road to the eastern gate of the village and move a little bit farther south.
It's in the 3 o'clock direction when you open the map.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·格林瓦尔德]
我建议你沿着中央道路走到村庄的东门，然后再往南走一点。
打开地图看的话，是在3点钟方向。

scripts.text:
[Walter Greenwald]
There, you can meet people who offer jobs and meals.
And, of course, they're surrounded by others who want the jobs and meals.
scripts.translation:
[瓦尔特·格林瓦尔德]
在那里，你可以遇到提供工作和食物的人。
当然，周围也围满了想要工作和食物的人。

scripts.text:
[Delbert Lake]
I'm not going back home until I become a millionaire!
I was so excited to come here that I got aboard the ship in full mining gear!
scripts.translation:
[德尔伯特·莱克]
在成为百万富翁之前，我不会回家的！
我兴奋得穿着全套采矿装备就上了船！

scripts.text:
[Delbert Lake]
There's a nice-looking rock! Alley-oop!
Come out, gold, silver, diamonds! You can't hide from Delbert!
scripts.translation:
[德尔伯特·莱克]
有一块看起来不错的岩石！接球！
出来吧，黄金、白银、钻石！你们逃不出德尔伯特的眼睛！

scripts.text:
[Constance]
Hey, are you crazy?!
That's not a mineral vein, it's a decorative rock! Get that pickax away from it, now!
scripts.translation:
[康斯坦丝]
嘿，你疯了吗？！
那不是矿脉，那是装饰用的石头！马上把镐子拿开！

scripts.text:
[Constance]
Ah, are you an adventurer? Please, help me stop that madman!
scripts.translation:
[康斯坦丝]
啊，你是冒险者吗？请帮我把那个疯子拦住！

scripts.text:
[Constance]
He got off a ship from the mainland in that heavy mining gear, and then one look at that rock, he turned into a pickax-swinging maniac.
scripts.translation:
[康斯坦丝]
他穿着厚重的采矿装备从大陆坐船过来，然后看了一眼那块石头，就变成了一个挥舞镐子的疯子。

scripts.text:
[Constance]
It's not a mineral vein but a decorative rock that we villagers moved together. I told him that, but he doesn't care!
He's in full mining gear, but he can't tell a normal rock from a mineral vein. How stupid is that?
scripts.translation:
[康斯坦丝]
那不是矿脉，而是我们村民一起搬来的装饰石头。我告诉他了，但他根本不听！
他穿着全套采矿装备，却分不清普通石头和矿脉。这也太蠢了吧？

scripts.text:
[Roland Burts]
Our village is protected by its own group of vigilantes.
They keep guard over it under Sheriff Warp's command.
scripts.translation:
[罗兰·伯茨]
我们的村庄由一支义警队伍保护。
他们在警长沃普的指挥下守护着这里。

scripts.text:
[Roland Burts]
Our biggest threat is undoubtedly the Buffalo Bandits, but we also have problems with some wild animals.
And under the village, there's?*Shudder* let's not go there.
scripts.translation:
[罗兰·伯茨]
我们最大的威胁无疑是野牛强盗，但我们也有一些野生动物造成的麻烦。
而在村庄地下... *颤抖* 还是别提了吧。

scripts.text:
[Loretta]
Welcome to the city of freedom, Rock Ridge. Odin is with you wherever you go!
Come to us if you want to hear the god's words.
scripts.translation:
[洛蕾塔]
欢迎来到自由之城，洛克理奇。奥丁与你同在，无论你去往何方！
如果你想聆听神谕，请来找我们。

scripts.text:
[Loretta]
We don't need a chapel. Odin doesn't come to buildings, he comes to our hearts.
Let's pray to him and show him our gratitude.
scripts.translation:
[洛蕾塔]
我们不需要教堂。奥丁不会降临在建筑里，他会降临在我们的心中。
让我们祈祷，向他表达我们的感激之情。

scripts.text:
[Dolores]
Sister Loretta, my legs hurt. *Whine*
He may not come to buildings, but I want to go sit in one.
scripts.translation:
[多洛雷丝]
洛蕾塔姐妹，我的腿好疼。*抱怨*
他也许不会降临在建筑里，但我想找个地方坐下来。

scripts.text:
[Dolores]
Ah, that's it, Brother Maurice!
scripts.translation:
[多洛雷丝]
啊，就是这里，莫里斯兄弟！

scripts.text:
[Loretta]
...Sigh. When the last ship of the day enters the dock, I'll buy you lemonade, limeade, whatever you want.
So for now, act like the god's servant that you are.
scripts.translation:
[洛蕾塔]
...叹气。等今天最后一艘船进港后，我会给你买柠檬水、青柠水，或者你想喝的任何东西。
所以现在，请像个神的仆人那样表现吧。

scripts.text:
[Maurice]
Lemonade! I mean, the god is with you!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
柠檬水！我是说，神与你同在！

scripts.text:
[Dolores]
I agree that our heart is our chapel.
But a god can come to cozy bedrooms and a nice-smelling kitchen. We don't have to stand all day in windy ports.
scripts.translation:
[多洛雷丝]
我同意我们的心脏就是教堂。
但神也可以降临在舒适的卧室和香气宜人的厨房。我们不必整天站在风大的港口。

scripts.text:
[Loretta]
If someone else hears you, they'd think you weren't fed or allowed to sleep for days
when, in fact, you wake up later than the rest of us, every day.
scripts.translation:
[洛蕾塔]
如果让别人听到你这么说，他们会以为你已经好几天没吃饭也没睡觉了。
而事实上，你每天都比我们醒得更晚。

scripts.text:
[Dolores]
Wh-what can I do? The god visits me in my dreams.
I'm not trying to wake up late!
scripts.translation:
[多洛雷丝]
我...我能怎么办？神在我的梦中造访我。
我不是故意睡懒觉的！

scripts.text:
[Maurice]
As I get older, it's getting more difficult to stand outside all day, spreading his words.
But I'm as resolved to complete my mission as I was the first day I arrived here.
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
随着年纪增长，整天站在户外传播神谕变得越来越困难。
但我完成使命的决心，与我初来此地时一样坚定。

scripts.text:
[Maurice]
I'm not going to let my physical exhaustion get in the way.
I'll use every ounce of energy in me to spread his teachings to the people of this new land!
scripts.translation:
[莫里斯]
我不会让身体的疲惫成为阻碍。
我将用我所有的能量，向这片新土地的人们传播他的教义！

scripts.text:
[Cordell]
I feel happy just by looking at the train station. It's the symbol of our village, you know.
scripts.translation:
[科德尔]
光是看着火车站我就感到幸福。你知道的，它是我们村庄的象征。

scripts.text:
[Cordell]
The mine was pretty far from the village, so transporting ores was a big problem in the beginning.
scripts.translation:
[科德尔]
矿场离村庄相当远，所以起初运输矿石是个大问题。

scripts.text:
[Cordell]
The actual development of Rock Ridge began after the train system was finally introduced.
Okay, that also aggravated the problem with the Buffalo Bandits, but there's always a dark side to everything.
scripts.translation:
[科德尔]
洛克理奇的实际发展是在铁路系统最终引入之后才开始的。
好吧，这也加剧了野牛强盗的问题，但凡事都有两面性。

scripts.text:
[Cordell]
But we the people of Rock Ridge are not here to give in, we're here to conquer!
scripts.translation:
[科德尔]
但我们洛克理奇的人民不会屈服，我们要征服一切！

scripts.text:
[Eloise McCurdy]
I pride myself in protecting cargo here.
My job is to protect it against rain, wind, and of course thieves.
scripts.translation:
[埃洛伊丝·麦柯迪]
我为能在这里保护货物而感到自豪。
我的工作是保护货物免受风雨侵袭，当然还有小偷。

scripts.text:
[Eloise McCurdy]
Recently though... Hmpf, my pride has been crushed by those damnable Buffalo Bandits.
scripts.translation:
[埃洛伊丝·麦柯迪]
不过最近...哼，我的自尊心被那些该死的野牛强盗击碎了。

scripts.text:
[Loading Dock Foreman]
The train brings ores from the mine, and brings supplies for the miners from this dock.
scripts.translation:
[装卸区工头]
火车从矿场运来矿石，并从这个码头运来矿工所需的补给品。

scripts.text:
[Loading Dock Foreman]
That's why this place is always busy. A delay here causes a delay everywhere else in Rock Ridge.
scripts.translation:
[装卸区工头]
这就是为什么这里总是忙得不可开交。这里的延误会导致洛克理奇其他地方的连锁延误。

scripts.text:
[Loading Dock Foreman]
Stop whining like wimps. Be proud to be part of the team and work harder!
scripts.translation:
[装卸区工头]
别像懦夫一样抱怨了。为能成为团队的一员感到自豪，然后更努力地工作！

scripts.text:
[Jader]
Ah, I can't move. I'm aching all over.
It doesn't matter whether or not the train comes often. We're always busy.
scripts.translation:
[贾德尔]
啊，我动不了了。浑身都疼。
不管火车来得勤不勤，我们总是很忙。

scripts.text:
[Loading Dock Foreman]
Hmpf, you're not working hard enough. Tsk, tsk.
You should be happy you have a job while many others don't!
scripts.translation:
[装卸区工头]
哼，你工作不够努力。啧，啧。
你应该庆幸自己有工作，而很多人却没有！

scripts.text:
[Jader]
*Gasp* H-how long have you been standing there? O-of course, I'm happy to have a job!
I-I love working at this loading dock. It's the best job I've ever had!
scripts.translation:
[贾德尔]
*倒吸一口凉气* 你...你站在那儿多久了？当...当然，我很庆幸有工作！
我...我喜欢在装卸区工作。这是我做过最棒的工作！

scripts.text:
[Rosco Richie]
Now that there are more people in the village, there are fewer jobs available. I'm glad I have a job that pays enough to feed my family.
scripts.translation:
[罗斯科·里奇]
现在村里人多了，工作机会就少了。我很庆幸自己有一份能养活家人的工作。

scripts.text:
[Rosco Richie]
Hah, hah! I can do this for my daughter!
scripts.translation:
[罗斯科·里奇]
哈哈！为了我的女儿，我可以做到！

scripts.text:
[Portnias]
I came here because I heard I could become rich quickly, nya.
I got on a ship to Rock Ridge as soon as I got off the ship from Pa-sta.
scripts.translation:
[波特尼亚斯]
我听说这里能很快发财，所以来了，喵。
我刚从帕斯塔下船，就立刻登上了去洛克理奇的船。

scripts.text:
[Portnias]
Now, I don't care about money anymore. I just want to rest. Nya...
I've been moving cargo every day since I came here, and my back is killing me. *Mewl*
scripts.translation:
[波特尼亚斯]
现在，我不在乎钱了。我只想休息。喵...
自从来到这里，我每天都在搬运货物，背都要断了。*喵呜*

scripts.text:
[Portnias]
At this rate, I'd spend all the Zeny I've earned on paying hospital bills. *Mewl*
scripts.translation:
[波特尼亚斯]
照这样下去，我赚的Zeny都会用来付医药费了。*喵呜*

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
I want to go home. We're never going to make a lot of money here.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
我想回家。我们在这里永远也赚不到大钱。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
No. We just have to stay strong until this is over. There'll be an opportunity for us afterward.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
不。我们必须坚持下去直到结束。之后会有机会的。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
But this is too much to handle. I don't think I can do this anymore.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
但这太难以应付了。我觉得我再也做不下去了。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
Come on, let's be patient for a little longer.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
加油，再耐心坚持一会儿吧。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
Sigh... I miss my mom.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
唉...我想妈妈了。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
Why isn't there any metal here? Some must have dropped when the train was attacked.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
这里怎么没有金属？有些可能在火车被袭击时掉下来了。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
If there was, someone else has to have found it by now.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
如果有的话，肯定早就被别人捡走了。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
Sigh, then there's nothing here we could sell. Where should we go now?
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
唉，那我们在这里没什么可卖的了。我们现在该去哪儿？

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
Maybe we should go back to the mainland.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
也许我们应该回大陆去。

scripts.text:
[Scrap Metal Collector]
What? No! I don't want to be a liar! We told our family we'd be back with loads of money.
scripts.translation:
[废金属回收者]
什么？不！我不想当骗子！我们告诉家人我们会带着很多钱回来。

scripts.text:
[Customer]
There aren't many people in this restaurant.
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
这家餐厅里没什么人。

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Who would want to eat such terrible food?
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
谁会想吃这么难吃的东西呢？

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Oh, do you know where the best eatery in this place is?
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
哦，你知道这里最好的餐馆在哪里吗？

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Where?
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
在哪里？

scripts.text:
[Customer]
The sheriff's office. Those in the underground jail are fed three times a day, and the food is so great that some people actually commit a misdemeanor for it.
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
在警长办公室。地牢里的囚犯每天吃三顿饭，而且食物好到有些人为了吃它故意犯小错。

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Does that make sense to you? I don't believe there's prison food worth committing a crime for.
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
你信吗？我不相信有什么监狱饭菜值得为了它去犯罪。

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Why are they staring at us?
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
他们为什么一直盯着我们看？

scripts.text:
[Customer]
They're begging.
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
他们在乞讨。

scripts.text:
[Customer]
Ugh, their staring eyes are making me feel too uncomfortable to eat.
scripts.translation:
[顾客]
唉，他们盯着我看，让我吃不下饭。

scripts.text:
[Camel]
Ga-a-ah.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼]
嘎——啊。

scripts.text:
[Camel]
*Snort*
scripts.translation:
[骆驼]
*喷鼻息*

scripts.text:
[Camel]
Why do you keep poking at me?
scripts.translation:
[骆驼]
你为什么一直戳我？

scripts.text:
[Camel]
...Oops.
Forget you heard me.
scripts.translation:
[骆驼]
...哎呀。
就当没听见我说话吧。

scripts.text:
[Camel]
Ga-a-a-ah.

[Herman Farland]
Ah, yes, this is the sheriff's office. Do you have to wait in line, you ask?
scripts.translation:
[赫尔曼·法兰德]
啊，是的，这里是警长办公室。你在问要不要排队吗？

scripts.text:
[Herman Farland]
Mm, you're an adventurer, right? Then just move past that door and go straight ahead.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔曼·法兰德]
嗯，你是冒险者，对吧？那就直接穿过那扇门，一直往前走。

scripts.text:
[Herman Farland]
You're here to help the Sheriff, right? We're here to ask him for help, so I understand you have to see him before the rest of us.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔曼·法兰德]
你是来帮警长的，对吧？我们是在向他求助，所以我理解你需要先于我们见到他。

scripts.text:
[Herman Farland]
Never mind me. I completely understand. Aww, I've been standing on my feet for so long, I can barely move my legs!
scripts.translation:
[赫尔曼·法兰德]
别管我了。我完全理解。哎呀，我站了太久，腿都快动不了了！

scripts.text:
[Edel Peppina]
The sheriff's office is understaffed. I've been waiting in line all day, and the line is as long as it was when I first arrived. I've been hearing strange noises from my basement, and I really need someone to come and check them.
scripts.translation:
[埃德尔·佩皮娜]
警长办公室人手不足。我排了一整天的队，队伍还是和刚来时一样长。我听到地下室传来奇怪的声音，真的需要有人来检查一下。

scripts.text:
[Edel Peppina]
Our sheriff doesn't have legal authority, but still his office is the only place that we could turn to for this kind of thing.
scripts.translation:
[埃德尔·佩皮娜]
我们的警长没有执法权，但他的办公室是我们唯一能求助的地方。

scripts.text:
[Edel Peppina]
I hope things in the village will settle soon, starting with this line.
scripts.translation:
[埃德尔·佩皮娜]
希望村里的事情能尽快平息，先从这条队伍开始吧。

scripts.text:
[Wilfred Sagan]
The sheriff has been so busy dealing with the Buffalo Bandits that he doesn't have time for anything else. I've been here waiting for him for hours.
scripts.translation:
[威尔弗雷德·萨根]
警长一直在忙着处理野牛强盗的事，根本没时间顾及其他。我在这里等了他好几个小时了。

scripts.text:
[Hilliard]
Many people in the village are jobless, and all available jobs are given to adventurers.
scripts.translation:
[希利亚德]
村里很多人失业了，而所有的工作机会都给了冒险者。

scripts.text:
[Hilliard]
The only thing that thrives because of this influx of adventurers is the inn.
Maybe I should've opened an inn myself.
scripts.translation:
[希利亚德]
唯一因为冒险者涌入而兴旺的，就是旅店了。
也许我也该开一家旅店。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Welcome to the Lazy Owl's Inn.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
欢迎光临懒猫旅店。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Looking for a place to stay? You came to the right place!
Would you like a room? It's 5,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
在找住的地方吗？您来对地方了！
需要房间吗？价格是5,000 Zeny。

scripts.text: Save.
scripts.translation: 存档

scripts.text: Get a room at 5,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 以5,000 Zeny的价格开一间房

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Saved. Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
已存档。欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
I'm sorry, but it's 5,000 Zeny to get a room.
If you don't have enough money, then I can't let you stay.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
很抱歉，开一间房需要5,000 Zeny。
如果您钱不够，我就不能让您住下了。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Enjoy your stay at the Lazy Owl's.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
祝您在懒猫旅店住得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Innkeeper]
Please come again.
scripts.translation:
[旅店老板]
欢迎下次光临。

scripts.text:
[Wanderer Doram]
Boohoo! Where the hell is the sheriff's office? My money! Moneeeyyy!
scripts.translation:
[漂泊的多兰]
呜呜！警长办公室到底在哪里啊？我的钱！我的钱啊！

scripts.text:
[Wanderer Doram]
Everyone said Rock Ridge is the land of opportunity! Why didn't anyone tell me about the scary Buffalo Bandits?
scripts.translation:
[漂泊的多兰]
大家都说洛克理奇是充满机遇的土地！为什么没人告诉我这里有可怕的野牛强盗？

scripts.text:
[Wanderer Doram]
*Hiccups* They robbed me clean. I don't even have enough money left to have a glass of Kahluna Milk.
scripts.translation:
[漂泊的多兰]
*打嗝* 他们把我洗劫一空。我现在连买一杯卡鲁哇牛奶的钱都不够了。

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
Grandpa said we shouldn't follow strangers, or they'd pluck all our thorns. What if he was telling me the truth?
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
爷爷说不要跟着陌生人走，否则他们会拔掉我们所有的刺。万一他说的是真的怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
Boohoo! Grandma! Boohoo!
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
呜呜！奶奶！呜呜！

scripts.text:
[Nahari]
Don't worry. Your thorns are so sharp, no one would dare touch them.
Do I still have the flower on my head?
scripts.translation:
[纳哈里]
别担心。你的刺那么锋利，没人敢碰的。
我头上还戴着那朵花吗？

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
*Sniffle* Yes, it's as pretty as the last time I checked.
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
*抽泣* 是的，和我上次检查时一样漂亮。

scripts.text:
[Nahari]
Then we're all right. Let's just keep moving, and we'll meet Grandma soon.
Let's check over there.
scripts.translation:
[纳哈里]
那就没事了。我们继续走吧，很快就能见到奶奶了。
我们去那边看看。

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
I can't lose all my thorns and have a smooth face. I'll be so ashamed that I'd want to bury myself in the ground.
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
我不能失去所有的刺，变成一张光滑的脸。我会羞愧得想把自己埋进土里。

scripts.text:
[Nahari]
This place is amazing. Look at these big wooden houses.
There are trees growing on the sea, and they all look alike.
scripts.translation:
[纳哈里]
这里太棒了。看看这些巨大的木屋。
海面上长着树，而且它们看起来都一模一样。

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
*Whine* Nahari, Grandma is not going to be happy with us.
Let's go back before she gets worried.
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
*呜咽* 纳哈里，奶奶会生气的。
趁她还没担心起来，我们快回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Nahari]
But we don't even know where we are.
Let's look around for a little longer. Look, there are a lot of strangers over there!
scripts.translation:
[纳哈里]
但我们甚至不知道自己在哪。
再四处看看吧。看，那边有很多陌生人！

scripts.text:
[Akuha]
What if we can't go back home?
scripts.translation:
[阿库哈]
万一我们回不了家怎么办？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Maybe we should explore beyond the mine, and go deep as far as we can.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
也许我们应该去矿洞深处探索，尽可能走得更远。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
What if it's too dangerous? I said we should take a detour and go someplace else.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
万一太危险了怎么办？我说过我们应该绕道去别的地方。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Or we could become the pathfinders of an unknown world!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
或者我们可以成为未知世界的开拓者！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
No. The east side is overrun with the Buffalo Bandits. We should wait until the situation with them is resolved.
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
不行。东边到处都是野牛强盗。我们应该等那里的局势稳定下来再说。

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Those darn Buffalo Bandits!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
那些讨厌的野牛强盗！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I've decided! I'm going to join the Vigilantes!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我决定了！我要加入义警！

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
Are you sure they'll let you in?
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
你确定他们会让你加入吗？

scripts.text:
[Traveler]
I don't know, but I'm tired of twiddling my thumbs. This can't be the end of our journey!
scripts.translation:
[旅行者]
我不知道，但我受够了无所事事。这不能是我们旅程的终点！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
We haven't worked for days. Can you believe that?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我们已经好几天没干活了。你能相信吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
We can't work, and yet we're not allowed to leave. How unfair is that?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我们不能工作，又不被允许离开。这也太不公平了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
If this doesn't get solved by tomorrow, then I'm leaving!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
如果明天还没解决，我就辞职！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
It seems we wouldn't be working today, just like yesterday and the day before.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
看来今天又不用工作了，就像昨天和前天一样。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'd hate to go back home empty-handed again.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我不想再一次空手回家。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Maybe I should deal with the Buffalo Bandits myself.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
也许我应该自己去对付那些野牛强盗。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
When can we start working again?
scripts.translation:
[工头]
我们什么时候能重新开始工作？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
How long do we have to wait around?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我们还要等多久？

scripts.text:
[Foreman]
Ah, guys, please calm down.
scripts.translation:
[工头]
啊，大家，请冷静一下。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
You calm down. We're losing money every hour just by sitting around.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
你冷静什么。我们每坐在这里一小时，就在损失金钱。

scripts.text:
[Foreman]
We can't do anything until we get our supplies.
scripts.translation:
[工头]
在收到物资之前，我们什么都做不了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
And when would that be?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
那什么时候能收到？

scripts.text:
[Foreman]
There's nothing we could do. The Buffalo Bandits stole our last shipment, and it won't be the last time they do it.
scripts.translation:
[工头]
我们无能为力。野牛强盗抢走了我们最后一批货物，而且这不会是最后一次。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I don't care. If I can't work tomorrow, then I'll walk out of here!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我不在乎。如果我明天不能工作，我就辞职！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Does the sheriff even care about this situation?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
警长在乎这种情况吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
He'd better.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
他最好在乎。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Maybe I should join the Vigilantes.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
也许我应该加入义警。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Forget it. I tried, and got flat out rejected.
scripts.translation:
[工人]
算了。我试过，被直接拒绝了。

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Sigh... How long do we have to wait?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
唉...我们还要等多久？

scripts.text:
[Eznia]
Did you know most buildings on the first level of Rock Ridge have a gigantic signboard in front of them?
scripts.translation:
[埃兹尼娅]
你知道洛克理奇第一层的大多数建筑前面都有一个巨大的招牌吗？

scripts.text:
[Eznia]
It's an interesting phenomenon. I think the signboards are supposed to make the buildings look like they have two stories, at least on the front.
scripts.translation:
[埃兹尼娅]
这是一个有趣的现象。我觉得这些招牌是为了让建筑看起来像有两层，至少从正面看是这样。

scripts.text:
[Eznia]
Actually, they used to be two stories before the basement was created. The owners must miss having two stories.
scripts.translation:
[埃兹尼娅]
实际上，在地下室建成之前，它们确实是两层的。店主们一定怀念有两层的日子。

scripts.text:
[Alain Morlein]
Hey, why can't you give me a loan?
scripts.translation:
[阿兰·莫兰]
嘿，为什么不能给我贷款？

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
We're sorry, but we do not offer services to individual customers.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
很抱歉，我们不向个人客户提供服务。

scripts.text:
[Alain Morlein]
Are you kidding me? I used your services yesterday. Look, don't you remember me?
scripts.translation:
[阿兰·莫兰]
你在开玩笑吗？我昨天还用了你们的服务。看，你不记得我了吗？

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Let me see your ID. As you know, a lot of people here look alike.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
请出示您的证件。如您所知，这里很多人长得都很像。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
I'm responsible for all transaction errors caused by misidentification. Please, you have to understand me.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
我需要对因身份识别错误导致的所有交易错误负责。请理解我。

scripts.text:
[Alain Morlein]
*Snort*
scripts.translation:
[阿兰·莫兰]
*哼*

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Thank you for your understanding. Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
感谢您的理解。祝您有美好的一天。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Hello.
Welcome to GC Bank's Rock Ridge branch. How may I assist you today?
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
您好。
欢迎光临GC银行洛克理奇分行。请问今天有什么可以帮您？

scripts.text: Check my bank account.
scripts.translation: 查询我的银行账户。

scripts.text: Buy an investment product.
scripts.translation: 购买理财产品。

scripts.text: What's GC Bank?
scripts.translation: GC银行是什么？

scripts.text: I'm just stopping by.
scripts.translation: 我只是路过。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
{0}, right?
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
您是{0}，对吗？

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
You don't have an account with us, but you do have an account under the name of {0}. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
您在我们这里没有账户，但您名下有一个名为{0}的账户。今天还有其他我可以为您做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
We're sorry,
but our investment products are only for businesses.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
很抱歉，
我们的理财产品仅面向企业客户。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Do you mean this bank?
Not many people know about it because it doesn't have many branches yet.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
您是指这家银行吗？
因为分行还不多，知道它的人并不多。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
And its main customers are companies and other businesses.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
而且它的主要客户是公司和其他企业。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Of course, we serve individual customers as well, but companies are what keep most banks in business.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
当然，我们也为个人客户提供服务，但维持大多数银行运营的是企业客户。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
This is just a rumor, but the founder of GC Bank named his bank after what he loved the most: gold coins.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
这只是个传闻，但GC银行的创始人以他最喜爱的东西命名了这家银行：金币。

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Can't you see the big beautiful gold coin on the roof of this building?
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
您没看到这座大楼屋顶上那枚又大又漂亮的金币吗？

scripts.text:
[Bank Clerk]
Hah hah, I see.
We're in a desert and I can't go into the building, but I hope you'll enjoy your stay.
scripts.translation:
[银行职员]
哈哈，我明白了。
我们在沙漠里，我进不了大楼，但希望您在这里过得愉快。

scripts.text:
[Gunslinger Posh]
Are you looking for a good weapon? You know guns are the main weapons of this area, right?
scripts.translation:
[神枪手 波什]
您在找好武器吗？您知道枪是这个地区的主要武器，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Gunslinger Posh]
Ah, the shop is closed. Sanders, the owner, went out to the desert, swinging a gun, to hunt the Buffalo Bandits himself. Then he fell and hurt his back.
scripts.translation:
[神枪手 波什]
啊，商店关门了。店主桑德斯拿着枪去沙漠里亲自打猎野牛强盗，结果摔了一跤，伤了背。

scripts.text:
[Gunslinger Posh]
Don't worry. You can still buy a gun. Sanders Jr. has rented a corner of the tool shop, so he could sell a few guns there.
scripts.translation:
[神枪手 波什]
别担心。您还是能买到枪的。桑德斯 Jr. 在工具店租了一个角落，可以在那里卖几把枪。

scripts.text:
[Gunslinger Posh]
He doesn't carry as wide a selection of products as his father, but he has an assortment of well-chosen models.
scripts.translation:
[神枪手 波什]
他的产品种类没有他父亲那么齐全，但他有一些精心挑选的型号。

scripts.text:
[White Twig]
Akuha! Nahari! Where have they gone?
scripts.translation:
[白枝]
阿库哈！纳哈里！你们去哪儿了？

scripts.text:
[White Twig]
Have you seen a couple of Cactus children, a boy and a girl?
I've brought them here to show them around the strangers' village, and I lost them in a crowd.
scripts.translation:
[白枝]
你们看到一对仙人掌小孩了吗？一男一女。
我把他们带到这里，想让他们看看这个陌生人的村庄，结果在人堆里走散了。

scripts.text:
[White Twig]
What should I do? Akuha! Nahari!
If you see them, please tell them their grandma is looking for them.
scripts.translation:
[白枝]
我该怎么办？阿库哈！纳哈里！
如果你们看到他们，请告诉他们老奶奶在找他们。

scripts.text:
[Carola Firth]
Did you hear that? The basement is haunted!
scripts.translation:
[卡萝拉·菲尔斯]
你听到了吗？地下室闹鬼了！

scripts.text:
[Carola Firth]
Word is that some worker couldn't get out in time before the basement was buried.
This place has so many people coming in and out of it, it's hard to keep track of every one of them.
scripts.translation:
[卡萝拉·菲尔斯]
听说有个工人在地下室被掩埋前没能及时逃出来。
这里进进出出的人太多了，很难记住每一个人。

scripts.text:
[Carola Firth]
Some workers went down to the basement for repair work and heard strange rustling noises.
When they found the source of noise? kyaaaahhh!
scripts.translation:
[卡萝拉·菲尔斯]
有些工人下去地下室做修复工作，听到了奇怪的沙沙声。
当他们找到声音来源时？啊——！

scripts.text:
[Carola Firth]
Lucas! Do you want me to kill you? Stop doing that!
Aww, I'm too scared to talk about this anymore.
scripts.translation:
[卡萝拉·菲尔斯]
卢卡斯！你想让我杀了你吗？别那样做！
哎呀，我吓得不敢再提这件事了。

scripts.text:
[Lucas Richie]
The basement is haunted. You don't really believe that, do you?
I think there are treasures down there.
scripts.translation:
[卢卡斯·里奇]
地下室闹鬼。你不会真的相信吧？
我觉得下面有宝物。

scripts.text:
[Lucas Richie]
And whoever spread that stupid rumor, he did it to keep others from finding out about the treasures.
scripts.translation:
[卢卡斯·里奇]
而且散布那个愚蠢谣言的人，是为了阻止别人发现宝物。

scripts.text:
[Lucas Richie]
Hm, I meant that as a joke, but maybe she really is scared.
What do you say, Carola? How'd you like to go down there with me?
Ah, adventurer. Let's keep this just between you and me, okay?
scripts.translation:
[卢卡斯·里奇]
嗯，我那是开玩笑，但她可能真的害怕。
卡萝拉，你觉得怎么样？愿意和我一起去下面看看吗？
啊，冒险者。这件事就让我们之间保密，好吗？

scripts.text:
[Bounty Hunter]
What am I looking at? Ah, those buffaloes. There's a large sum of money offered for their heads.
scripts.translation:
[赏金猎人]
我在看什么？啊，那些野牛。有人出大价钱悬赏它们的头。

scripts.text:
[Bounty Hunter]
The Vigilantes and the Sheriff have had enough with them, now that they started robbing the train.
scripts.translation:
[赏金猎人]
义警和警长对它们忍无可忍，因为它们开始抢劫火车了。

scripts.text:
[Bounty Hunter]
But thanks to them, I've got a lucrative job.
scripts.translation:
[赏金猎人]
但多亏了它们，我接到了一个 lucrative 的工作。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I'm sorry, guys. I should've never taken you here...
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
对不起，伙计们。我不该带你们来这里的...

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
I didn't know there was no grass here.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
我不知道这里没有草。

scripts.text:
[Shepherd]
Just hang in there. I'm growing some grass for you out there. If it grows well, you wouldn't have to be hungry anymore.
scripts.translation:
[牧羊人]
再坚持一下。我在外面给你们种些草。如果长得好的话，你们就不用挨饿了。

scripts.text:
[Joyce Leslie]
The houses closer to the beach have always been prone to sinking, long before the first level was buried.
This house sank little by little, until the ground couldn't hold its weight anymore.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯·莱斯利]
靠近海滩的房子一直容易下沉，早在第一层被掩埋之前就是这样。
这栋房子一点一点下沉，直到地面再也承受不住它的重量。

scripts.text:
[Joyce Leslie]
What happened to its residents, you ask? You're an adventurer, why do you care?
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯·莱斯利]
你问它的居民怎么样了？你是冒险者，为什么要在意？

scripts.text:
[Joyce Leslie]
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to get angry with you.
It's just that... things haven't been good.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯·莱斯利]
对不起，我不是故意对你发火的。
只是...最近情况不太好。

scripts.text:
[Joyce Leslie]
But at least I have work to do and food to eat, thanks to some people.
Where do I get work and food? Head up to the eastern gate. You'll see the along the way.
scripts.translation:
[乔伊斯·莱斯利]
但至少我有工作做，有饭吃，多亏了一些人。
我在哪里找工作和食物？去东边的门。你会在沿途看到。

scripts.text:
[Joe]
You're too weak
to enter the basement.
Please leave.
scripts.translation:
[乔]
你的实力太弱了，无法进入地下室。
请离开。

scripts.text:
[Joe]
Are you going to go in?
scripts.translation:
[乔]
你要进去吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Donovan]
...

[Joe]
You'd better get out of there
as soon as you're done.
scripts.translation:
[乔]
做完事就赶紧离开这里。

scripts.text:
[Smell Maniac]
*Sniff Sniff* Doesn't this place smell good to you? I love its salty, dank, musty smell! I could live here for the rest of my life!
scripts.translation:
[气味狂人]
*嗅嗅嗅* 你不觉得这里味道很好闻吗？我喜欢这种咸湿、阴暗、发霉的味道！我可以在这里度过余生！

scripts.text:
[Smell Maniac]
...If only there weren't so many bugs. I'm just going to bottle the smell and take it with me.
scripts.translation:
[气味狂人]
...要是没有那么多虫子就好了。我还是把味道装进瓶子里带走吧。

scripts.text:
[Unemployed Man]
See those sea anemones? They keep clogging up the sewer pipes, so we get rid of them on a regular basis. I like sitting here and watching them move. And when I do, time goes by so quickly.
scripts.translation:
[失业的男子]
看到那些沙漠向日葵了吗？它们总是堵塞下水道，所以我们定期清理它们。我喜欢坐在这里看它们移动。那时候，时间过得飞快。

scripts.text:
[Unemployed Man]
At least during that time I could forget my reality, about the mine, not having jobs, you know, that sort of thing.
scripts.translation:
[失业的男子]
至少在那段时间里，我可以忘记现实，忘记矿山，忘记失业，诸如此类的事情。

scripts.text:
[Unemployed Man]
I'm here because I have nowhere else to go, but I'll go back up once those who took up residence in the mine are gone.
scripts.translation:
[失业的男子]
我留在这里是因为无处可去，但等那些占据矿山的人离开后，我会回去的。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
This place hasn't changed at all.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
这里一点都没变。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Remember when we first came here?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
还记得我们第一次来这里的时候吗？

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
I do.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我记得。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
We built this house from scratch, on our own from the foundation stones to the roofing.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
这栋房子是我们亲手建的，从地基到屋顶。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Aww, it's getting chilly. Let's go back up.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哎呀，有点冷了。我们回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
My lovely Clementine... I proposed to her here.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我亲爱的克莱门汀...我在这里向她求婚了。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
I'm here.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
我在这里。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
My Clementine is not so old!
scripts.translation:
[老人]
我的克莱门汀不老！

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Grr, you senile coot!
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
哼，你这糊涂的老头！

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Mm? Who's there? Is it you, Charlie?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
嗯？是谁？是你吗，查理？

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
Charlie can't come here. He lives across the sea.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
查理不能来这里。他住在海的那一边。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Does he? By the way, this place has changed a lot.
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是吗？顺便说一句，这里变化好大啊。

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
No, it hasn't. It's just the same as when we left it.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
没有，没变。还是我们离开时的样子。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Is it? I come here when I miss the old days, but it's too dark. By the way, why has it become so wet?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是吗？我想念旧时光的时候就会来这里，但这里太黑了。顺便问一下，为什么这里变得这么潮湿？

scripts.text:
[Old Woman]
It was flooded. That's why it had to be filled up and we had to move up. Have you gone senile? You were the one who insisted this place was too low to build houses on.
scripts.translation:
[老妇人]
这里发过洪水。所以必须填平，我们也得搬上去。你老糊涂了吗？当初是你坚持说这里地势太低，不能盖房子的。

scripts.text:
[Old Man]
Was I?
scripts.translation:
[老人]
是我吗？

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mommy, when can we live above ground again?
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
妈妈，我们什么时候才能回到地面上生活？

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Soon. When Daddy can go work at the mine again. When Mommy and Daddy make enough money to buy back the house.
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
快了。等爸爸能回矿里工作，等我和妈妈赚到足够的钱买回房子。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
I want to go home...
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
我想回家...

scripts.text:
[Mom]
I haven't been able to feed my child well. I can't remember the last time he had a decent meal.
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
我没能好好喂饱孩子。我都不记得他上一次吃顿像样的饭是什么时候了。

scripts.text:
[Kid]
Mommy, I'm okay.
scripts.translation:
[小孩]
妈妈，我没事的。

scripts.text:
[Mom]
Let's wait for Daddy. He'll be back with food.
scripts.translation:
[妈妈]
我们等爸爸吧。他会带着食物回来的。

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
What, haven't you seen a Buffalo Bandit before?
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
怎么，没见过野牛强盗吗？

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
Don't give me that dirty look. We're not doing anything bad right now, now are we?
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
别用那种眼神看我。我们现在没在干坏事，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
You're on our turf. Don't cause trouble, and stay away from here.
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
这是我们的地盘。别惹事，离这里远点。

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
I'll let you come and go, if you promise me not to tell anyone above the ground about us. Promise?
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
只要你答应不把我们的事告诉地面上的人，我就让你自由进出。答应吗？

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
Aside from the main gate, there are are a few more entrances that only we know, and we guard one of them.
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
除了正门，还有几个只有我们知道入口，我们守着其中一个。

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
Why are you telling me this?
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
我为什么要告诉你这些？

scripts.text:
[Buffalo Bandit]
So you'd be scared and want to stay away.
scripts.translation:
[野牛强盗]
这样你就会害怕，然后想离这里远点。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Nun]
Can you believe some people actually live here? People above ground don't care about them. Officially, this place is vacant, even though it's not.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的修女]
你能相信有人真的住在这里吗？地面上的人根本不在乎他们。官方记录显示这里是空地，尽管事实并非如此。

scripts.text:
[Dispatched Nun]
They don't want to know or care. You have to be in a pretty bad situation to end up here.
scripts.translation:
[派遣的修女]
他们不想了解，也不在乎。除非处境非常艰难，否则不会落到这里来。

scripts.text:
[Erekter]
Erekter wants to become the best netter in the village when he grows up.
scripts.translation:
[埃雷克特]
埃雷克特长大后，想成为村里最厉害的织网人。

scripts.text:
[Erekter]
The best netter in the village is Mrs. Soft Feather.
scripts.translation:
[埃雷克特]
村里最厉害的织网人是软羽女士。

scripts.text:
[Erekter]
Mm... Then I'll become the second-best netter in the village!
scripts.translation:
[埃雷克特]
嗯...那我要成为村里第二厉害的织网人！

scripts.text:
[Soft Feather]
Ho ho ho, there's not a single fishing net in the village that hasn't been handled by me.
There are others who make good nets, but I'm the one who gives the nets their finishing touch.
scripts.translation:
[软羽]
呵呵呵，村里没有一张渔网没经过我的手。
虽然也有其他人织得不错，但最后都是我来做收尾工作。

scripts.text:
[Erekter]
I want to learn from you too! I want to become as good at netting as you!
scripts.translation:
[埃雷克特]
我也想跟你学！我想像你一样擅长织网！

scripts.text:
[Soft Feather]
Your hands are too soft right now. Go out and play. I'll teach you when your hands become tougher.
scripts.translation:
[软羽]
你现在的手太嫩了。先去外面玩吧，等你的手变粗糙了，我再教你。

scripts.text:
[Soft Feather]
Yes, I'll teach you how to net. For now, let me teach you how to make pretty knots with grass blades.
scripts.translation:
[软羽]
好，我会教你织网。不过现在，先让我教你怎么用草叶打漂亮的结。
